items.text:
अस्य श्रीललितासहस्रनामस्तोत्रमाला मन्त्रस्य वशिन्यादि वाग्देवता ऋषयः ।
अनुष्टुप् छन्दः । श्रीललितापरमेश्वरी देवता । श्रीमद्वाग्भवकूटेति बीजम् ।
मध्यकूटेति शक्तिः । शक्तिकूटेतिकीलकम् ।
श्रीललितामहात्रिपुरसुन्दरी प्रसादसिद्धिद्धारा चिन्तित फलावाप्त्यर्थे जपे विनियोगः । लमित्यादिञ्चपूजां कुर्यात् ।
items.tr:
asya śrīlalitāsahasranāmastotramālā mantrasya vaśinyādi vāgdevatā ṛṣayaḥ |
anuṣṭup chandaḥ | śrīlalitāparameśvarī devatā | śrīmadvāgbhavakūṭeti bījam |
madhyakūṭeti śaktiḥ | śaktikūṭetikīlakam |
śrīlalitāmahātripurasundarī prasādasiddhiddhārā cintita phalāvāptyarthe jape viniyogaḥ | lamityādiñcapūjāṃ kuryāt |
items.en: For this hymn, the garland of Lalita's thousand names, the seers are the goddesses of speech led by Vashini, the metre is anushtup, and the deity is Shri Lalita, the supreme goddess. The vagbhava part of her mantra is the seed, the middle part is the power, and the shakti part is the key. It is used in japa to gain the fruit one wishes for, through the grace of Lalita Mahatripurasundari; one then offers the five-fold worship that begins with 'lam'.

items.text:
सिन्दूरारुणविग्रहां त्रिनयनां माणिक्यमौलिस्फुरत्
तारानायकशेखरां स्मितमुखीमापीनवक्षोरुहाम् ।
पाणिभ्यामलिपूर्णरत्नचषकं रक्तोफळं बिभ्रतीं
सौम्या रत्नघटस्थरक्तचरणां ध्यायेत्पराम्बिकाम् ।।
items.tr:
sindūrāruṇavigrahāṃ trinayanāṃ māṇikyamaulisphurat
tārānāyakaśekharāṃ smitamukhīmāpīnavakṣoruhām |
pāṇibhyāmalipūrṇaratnacaṣakaṃ raktophaḷaṃ bibhratīṃ
saumyā ratnaghaṭastharaktacaraṇāṃ dhyāyetparāmbikām ||
items.en: Meditate on the supreme Mother. Her body is red like vermilion, she has three eyes, her ruby crown shines with the moon on it, she smiles, and her breasts are full. In her hands she holds a jewelled cup full of nectar and a red lotus; she is gentle, and her red feet rest on a jewelled pot.

items.text:
ॐ श्रीमाता श्रीमहाराज्ञी श्रीमत्सिंहासनेश्वरी ।
चिदग्रि – कुण्ड – सम्भूता- देवकार्य -समुद्यता ।।
items.tr:
oṃ śrīmātā śrīmahārājñī śrīmatsiṃhāsaneśvarī |
cidagri – kuṇḍa – sambhūtā- devakārya -samudyatā ||
items.en: She is the holy Mother (Shrimata), the great Queen (Shrimaharajni), the ruler of the glorious lion throne (Shrimatsimhasaneshvari). She rose from the fire-pit of pure consciousness (Chidagnikunda-sambhuta) and is ready to do the work of the gods (Devakarya-samudyata).

items.text:
उद्भानु -सहस्राभा -चर्तुबाहू -समन्विता ।
रागस्वरुप –पाशाढ्या- क्रोधाकारांक्कुशोज्ज्वाळा ।।
items.tr:
udbhānu -sahasrābhā -cartubāhū -samanvitā |
rāgasvarupa –pāśāḍhyā- krodhākārāṃkkuśojjvāḷā ||
items.en: She shines like a thousand rising suns (Udyadbhanu-sahasrabha) and has four arms (Chaturbahu-samanvita). She holds the noose that is desire (Ragasvarupa-pashadhya) and shines with the goad that is anger (Krodhakarankushojjvala).

items.text:
मनोरुपेक्षु -कोदण्डा -पञ्चतन्मात्र -सायका ।
निजारुण -प्रभापूर -मज्जद्वह्याण्ड -मण्डला ।।
items.tr:
manorupekṣu -kodaṇḍā -pañcatanmātra -sāyakā |
nijāruṇa -prabhāpūra -majjadvahyāṇḍa -maṇḍalā ||
items.en: Her sugarcane bow is the mind (Manorupekshu-kodanda) and her five arrows are the five subtle elements (Panchatanmatra-sayaka). The whole universe is bathed in the flood of her own red light (Nijaruna-prabhapura-majjad-brahmanda-mandala).

items.text:
चम्पकाशोक – पुन्नाग – सौगन्धिक –लसत्कचा ।
कुरुविन्द – मणि-श्रेणी – कनत्कोटीर – मण्डिता ।।
items.tr:
campakāśoka – punnāga – saugandhika –lasatkacā |
kuruvinda – maṇi-śreṇī – kanatkoṭīra – maṇḍitā ||
items.en: Her hair shines with champaka, ashoka, punnaga and saugandhika flowers (Champakashoka-punnaga-saugandhika-lasatkacha). She wears a crown glittering with rows of rubies (Kuruvinda-mani-shreni-kanatkotira-mandita).

items.text:
अष्टमीचन्द्र – विभ्राज – दलिकस्थल – शोभिता ।
मुखचन्द्र – कलंक्काभ – मृगनाभि – विशेषका ।।
items.tr:
aṣṭamīcandra – vibhrāja – dalikasthala – śobhitā |
mukhacandra – kalaṃkkābha – mṛganābhi – viśeṣakā ||
items.en: Her forehead shines like the half moon of the eighth night (Ashtamichandra-vibhraja-dalikasthala-shobhita). The musk mark on her face looks like the dark spot on the moon (Mukhachandra-kalankabha-mriganabhi-visheshaka).

items.text:
वदनस्मर – माङ्गळ्य – गृहतोरण – चिळ्लिका ।
वक्त्रलक्ष्मी – परिवाह- चलन्मीनाभ – लोचना ।।
items.tr:
vadanasmara – māṅgaḷya – gṛhatoraṇa – ciḷlikā |
vaktralakṣmī – parivāha- calanmīnābha – locanā ||
items.en: Her eyebrows are like the arched gate of the house of Kama, which is her face (Vadanasmara-mangalya-grihatorana-chillika). Her eyes move like fish in the flowing stream of her face's beauty (Vaktralakshmi-parivaha-chalanminabha-lochana).

items.text:
नवचम्पक – पुष्पाभ- नासादण्ड – विराजिता ।
ताराकान्ति- तिरस्कारि – नासाभरण-भासुरा ।।
items.tr:
navacampaka – puṣpābha- nāsādaṇḍa – virājitā |
tārākānti- tiraskāri – nāsābharaṇa-bhāsurā ||
items.en: Her nose is lovely like a fresh champaka bud (Navachampaka-pushpabha-nasadanda-virajita). Her nose jewel shines brighter than the stars (Tarakanti-tiraskari-nasabharana-bhasura).

items.text:
कदम्बमञ्जरी – क्लृप्त-कर्णपूर-मनोहरा ।
ताटङ्क – युगली-भूत – तपनोडुप – मण्डला ।।
items.tr:
kadambamañjarī – klṛpta-karṇapūra-manoharā |
tāṭaṅka – yugalī-bhūta – tapanoḍupa – maṇḍalā ||
items.en: She is lovely with ear ornaments made of kadamba flower clusters (Kadambamanjari-klripta-karnapura-manohara). The sun and the moon are her pair of earrings (Tatanka-yugali-bhuta-tapanodupa-mandala).

items.text:
पद्य्मरागशिलादर्श – परिभावि – कपोलभूः ।
नवविद्रुम – बिम्बश्री – न्यक्कारि – रदनच्छदा ।।
items.tr:
padymarāgaśilādarśa – paribhāvi – kapolabhūḥ |
navavidruma – bimbaśrī – nyakkāri – radanacchadā ||
items.en: Her cheeks are brighter than mirrors of ruby (Padmaragashiladarsha-paribhavi-kapolabhuh). Her lips are more beautiful than fresh coral and the red bimba fruit (Navavidruma-bimbashri-nyakkari-radanachchhada).

items.text:
शुद्धविद्यांकुराकार – द्विजपंक्ति – द्वयोज्ज्वला ।
कर्पूरवीटिकामोद – समाकर्ष-द्विगन्तरा ।।
items.tr:
śuddhavidyāṃkurākāra – dvijapaṃkti – dvayojjvalā |
karpūravīṭikāmoda – samākarṣa-dvigantarā ||
items.en: Her two rows of teeth shine like the first shoots of pure knowledge (Shuddhavidyankurakara-dvijapankti-dvayojjvala). The scent of the camphor betel she chews fills every direction (Karpuravitikamoda-samakarshi-digantara).

items.text:
निज – सळ्लाप – माधुर्य – विनर्भिर्त्सित – कच्छपी ।
मन्दस्मित – प्रभापूर – मज्ज्तकामेश – मानसा ।।
items.tr:
nija – saḷlāpa – mādhurya – vinarbhirtsita – kacchapī |
mandasmita – prabhāpūra – majjtakāmeśa – mānasā ||
items.en: The sweetness of her speech puts to shame the vina of Sarasvati (Nija-sallapa-madhurya-vinirbhartsita-kachchhapi). The mind of Kameshvara is bathed in the light of her soft smile (Mandasmita-prabhapura-majjat-kamesha-manasa).

items.text:
अनाकालित – सादृश्य – चुबुकश्री – विराजिता ।
कामेश – बद्ध-माङ्ग्ल्य-सूत्र-शोभित – कन्धरा ।।
items.tr:
anākālita – sādṛśya – cubukaśrī – virājitā |
kāmeśa – baddha-māṅglya-sūtra-śobhita – kandharā ||
items.en: She shines with the beauty of a chin that has no equal (Anakalita-sadrishya-chubukashri-virajita). Her neck is graced by the wedding thread tied by Kameshvara (Kamesha-baddha-mangalya-sutra-shobhita-kandhara).

items.text:
कनकाङ्ग्द – केयूर – कमनीय – भुजानविता ।
रत्नग्रैवेय – चिन्ताक – लोल- मुक्ता- फलान्विता ।।
items.tr:
kanakāṅgda – keyūra – kamanīya – bhujānavitā |
ratnagraiveya – cintāka – lola- muktā- phalānvitā ||
items.en: Her lovely arms wear golden armlets (Kanakangada-keyura-kamaniya-bhujanvita). She wears a jewelled necklace with a locket and swinging pearls (Ratnagraiveya-chintaka-lola-mukta-phalanvita).

items.text:
कामेश्वर – प्रेमरत्न-मणि – प्रतिपण – स्तनी ।
न्याभ्यालवाल – रोमालि – लता-फल-कुचद्वयी ।।
items.tr:
kāmeśvara – premaratna-maṇi – pratipaṇa – stanī |
nyābhyālavāla – romāli – latā-phala-kucadvayī ||
items.en: Her breasts are what she gives Kameshvara in return for the jewel of his love (Kameshvara-premaratna-mani-pratipana-stani). They are like two fruits on the creeper of fine hair that rises from her navel (Nabhyalavala-romali-lata-phala-kuchadvayi).

items.text: लक्ष्यरोम - लताधारता – समुन्नेय – मध्यमा ।।
items.tr: lakṣyaroma - latādhāratā – samunneya – madhyamā ||
items.en: Her waist is so slender that it can only be guessed from the fine line of hair that rests on it (Lakshyaroma-lata-dharata-samunneya-madhyama).

items.text: स्तनभार – दलन्मध्य – पट्टबन्ध – वलित्रया ।।
items.tr: stanabhāra – dalanmadhya – paṭṭabandha – valitrayā ||
items.en: Her waist has three folds, like a belt holding it as it bends under the weight of her breasts (Stanabhara-dalanmadhya-pattabandha-valitraya).

items.text:
अरुणारुणकौसुम्भ – वस्त्र – भास्वत् – कटीतटी ।
रत्न – किङ्किणिका – रम्य – रशना – दाम – भूषिता ।।
items.tr:
aruṇāruṇakausumbha – vastra – bhāsvat – kaṭītaṭī |
ratna – kiṅkiṇikā – ramya – raśanā – dāma – bhūṣitā ||
items.en: Her hips shine in a cloth dyed deep red like the dawn (Arunaruna-kausumbha-vastra-bhasvat-katitati). She is adorned with a lovely girdle of small jewelled bells (Ratna-kinkinika-ramya-rashana-dama-bhushita).

items.text:
कामेश – ज्ञात – सौभाग्य – मार्दुवोरु – द्वयान्विता ।
माण्यिकामुकुटाकार – जानुद्वय – विराजिता ।।
items.tr:
kāmeśa – jñāta – saubhāgya – mārduvoru – dvayānvitā |
māṇyikāmukuṭākāra – jānudvaya – virājitā ||
items.en: The beauty and softness of her thighs is known only to Kameshvara (Kamesha-jnata-saubhagya-mardavoru-dvayanvita). Her knees are shaped like crowns of ruby (Manikya-mukutakara-janudvaya-virajita).

items.text:
इन्द्रगोप – परिक्षिप्तस्मरणतूनाभ – जंघिका ।
गूढगुळ्फा – कूर्मपृष्ठ- ययिष्णु – प्रपदान्विता ।।
items.tr:
indragopa – parikṣiptasmaraṇatūnābha – jaṃghikā |
gūḍhaguḷphā – kūrmapṛṣṭha- yayiṣṇu – prapadānvitā ||
items.en: Her calves are like Kama's quivers, dotted with red indragopa insects (Indragopa-parikshipta-smaratunabha-janghika). Her ankles are hidden (Gudhagulpha) and the arches of her feet are curved more finely than a tortoise's back (Kurmaprishtha-jayishnu-prapadanvita).

items.text:
नख – दीधित – संछन्न – नमज्जन – तमोगुणा ।
पदद्वय – प्रभाजाल – पराकृत – सरोरुहा ।।
items.tr:
nakha – dīdhita – saṃchanna – namajjana – tamoguṇā |
padadvaya – prabhājāla – parākṛta – saroruhā ||
items.en: The light of her toenails removes the inner darkness of those who bow to her (Nakhadidhiti-sanchhanna-namajjana-tamoguna). The glow of her two feet defeats the lotus (Padadvaya-prabhajala-parakrita-saroruha).

items.text:
सिञ्जान – मणिमञ्जीर मण्डित – श्री-पदाम्बुजा ।
मराली-मन्दगमना – महालावण्य – शेवधिः ।।
items.tr:
siñjāna – maṇimañjīra maṇḍita – śrī-padāmbujā |
marālī-mandagamanā – mahālāvaṇya – śevadhiḥ ||
items.en: Her holy lotus feet are adorned with tinkling jewelled anklets (Shinjana-manimanjira-mandita-shripadambuja). She walks slowly like a swan (Marali-mandagamana) and is a treasure of great beauty (Mahalavanya-shevadhih).

items.text:
सर्वारुणाऽनवद्यांगी – सर्वाभरण – भूषिता ।
शिव कामेश्वराङ्कस्था – शिवा स्वाधीन – वल्लभा ।।
items.tr:
sarvāruṇā'navadyāṃgī – sarvābharaṇa – bhūṣitā |
śiva kāmeśvarāṅkasthā – śivā svādhīna – vallabhā ||
items.en: She is red all over (Sarvaruna), her body is flawless (Anavadyangi), and she wears every ornament (Sarvabharana-bhushita). She sits on the lap of Shiva Kameshvara (Shiva-kameshvarankastha), she is auspicious (Shiva), and her beloved is in her own power (Svadhina-vallabha).

items.text:
सुमेरु – मध्य – शृङ्गत्था – श्रीमन्नगर- नायिका ।
चिन्तामणि गृहान्तस्था पञ्च-ब्रह्मासन – स्थिता ।।
items.tr:
sumeru – madhya – śṛṅgatthā – śrīmannagara- nāyikā |
cintāmaṇi gṛhāntasthā pañca-brahmāsana – sthitā ||
items.en: She lives on the middle peak of Mount Sumeru (Sumeru-madhya-shringastha) and is the lady of the holy city (Shrimannagara-nayika). She lives in the house of wish-granting jewels (Chintamani-grihantastha) and sits on a seat made of the five Brahmas (Panchabrahmasana-sthita).

items.text:
महापद्य्माटवी – संस्था कदम्बवन – वासिनी ।
सुधासागर – मध्यस्था कामाक्षी कामदायिनी ।।
items.tr:
mahāpadymāṭavī – saṃsthā kadambavana – vāsinī |
sudhāsāgara – madhyasthā kāmākṣī kāmadāyinī ||
items.en: She lives in the great lotus forest (Mahapadmatavi-samstha) and in the kadamba grove (Kadambavana-vasini). She dwells in the middle of the ocean of nectar (Sudhasagara-madhyastha); she has loving eyes (Kamakshi) and grants wishes (Kamadayini).

items.text:
देवर्षि- गण- संघात – स्तूयमानात्म – वैभवा ।
भण्डासुर – वधोद्युक्त – शक्तिसेना – समान्विता ।।
items.tr:
devarṣi- gaṇa- saṃghāta – stūyamānātma – vaibhavā |
bhaṇḍāsura – vadhodyukta – śaktisenā – samānvitā ||
items.en: Her glory is praised by crowds of gods and sages (Devarshi-gana-sanghata-stuyamanatma-vaibhava). She is joined by an army of Shaktis ready to kill the demon Bhanda (Bhandasura-vadhodyukta-shaktisena-samanvita).

items.text:
सम्पत्करी – समारुढ – सिन्धुर – वज्र – सेविता ।
अश्र्वारुढाधिष्ठिताश्र – कोटि – कोटिभि – रावृता ।।
items.tr:
sampatkarī – samāruḍha – sindhura – vajra – sevitā |
aśrvāruḍhādhiṣṭhitāśra – koṭi – koṭibhi – rāvṛtā ||
items.en: She is served by a herd of elephants led by Sampatkari (Sampatkari-samarudha-sindhura-vraja-sevita). She is surrounded by countless horses led by Ashvarudha (Ashvarudhadhishthitashva-koti-kotibhir-avrita).

items.text:
चक्रराज – रथारुढ – सर्वायुध – परिष्कृता ।
गेयचक्र – रथारुढ – मंत्रिणी – परिसेविता ।।
items.tr:
cakrarāja – rathāruḍha – sarvāyudha – pariṣkṛtā |
geyacakra – rathāruḍha – maṃtriṇī – parisevitā ||
items.en: She stands on the chariot Chakraraja, armed with every weapon (Chakraraja-ratharudha-sarvayudha-parishkrita). She is served by Mantrini, who rides the chariot Geyachakra (Geyachakra-ratharudha-mantrini-parisevita).

items.text:
किरिचक्र – रथारुढ – दण्डनाथा – पुरस्कृता ।
ज्वालामालिनिकाक्षिप्त – मह्निप्राकार – मध्यगा ।।
items.tr:
kiricakra – rathāruḍha – daṇḍanāthā – puraskṛtā |
jvālāmālinikākṣipta – mahniprākāra – madhyagā ||
items.en: Dandanatha, riding the chariot Kirichakra, goes before her (Kirichakra-ratharudha-dandanatha-puraskrita). She stands inside the wall of fire raised by Jvalamalini (Jvalamalinikakshipta-vahniprakara-madhyaga).

items.text:
भण्डसैन्य – वधोयुक्त – शक्ति – विक्रम – हर्षिता ।
नित्या – पराक्रमाटोप – निरीक्षण- समुत्सुका ।।
items.tr:
bhaṇḍasainya – vadhoyukta – śakti – vikrama – harṣitā |
nityā – parākramāṭopa – nirīkṣaṇa- samutsukā ||
items.en: She is glad at the valour of the Shaktis set on destroying Bhanda's army (Bhandasainya-vadhodyukta-shakti-vikrama-harshita). She is eager to watch the strength and spirit of the Nitya goddesses (Nitya-parakramatopa-nirikshana-samutsuka).

items.text:
भण्डपुत्र – वधोद्युक्त – बाला – विक्रम – नन्दिता ।
मन्त्रिण्यम्बा – विरचित – विषङ्ग – वध – तोषिता ।।
items.tr:
bhaṇḍaputra – vadhodyukta – bālā – vikrama – nanditā |
mantriṇyambā – viracita – viṣaṅga – vadha – toṣitā ||
items.en: She delights in the valour of Bala, who set out to kill Bhanda's sons (Bhandaputra-vadhodyukta-bala-vikrama-nandita). She is pleased that Mantrini killed the demon Vishanga (Mantrinyamba-virachita-vishanga-vadha-toshita).

items.text:
विशुक्र – प्राणहरण – वाराही – वीर्य- नन्दिता ।
कामेश्वर – मुखालोक – कल्पित – श्रीगणेश्वरा ।।
items.tr:
viśukra – prāṇaharaṇa – vārāhī – vīrya- nanditā |
kāmeśvara – mukhāloka – kalpita – śrīgaṇeśvarā ||
items.en: She delights in the strength of Varahi, who took the life of Vishukra (Vishukra-pranaharana-varahi-virya-nandita). She brought forth Ganesha just by looking at Kameshvara's face (Kameshvara-mukhaloka-kalpita-shriganeshvara).

items.text:
महागणेश – निभिन्न – विघ्नयन्त्र – प्रहर्षिता ।
भण्डासुरेन्द्र – निर्मुक्त – शस्त्र – प्रयस्र – वर्षिणी
कराङ्गुलि – नखोत्पन्न – नारायण-दशाकृतिः ।
महा – पाशुपतास्राग्रि-निर्दग्धासुर – सैनिका ।।
items.tr:
mahāgaṇeśa – nibhinna – vighnayantra – praharṣitā |
bhaṇḍāsurendra – nirmukta – śastra – prayasra – varṣiṇī
karāṅguli – nakhotpanna – nārāyaṇa-daśākṛtiḥ |
mahā – pāśupatāsrāgri-nirdagdhāsura – sainikā ||
items.en: She is glad when Mahaganesha breaks the demon's device of obstacles (Mahaganesha-nirbhinna-vighnayantra-praharshita), and she rains a counter-weapon on every weapon Bhandasura throws (Bhandasurendra-nirmukta-shastra-pratyastra-varshini). The ten forms of Narayana came from her fingernails (Karanguli-nakhotpanna-narayana-dashakritih), and she burned the demon soldiers with the fire of the great Pashupata missile (Mahapashupatastragni-nirdagdhasura-sainika).

items.text:
कामेश्वरास्र – निर्दग्ध – सभण्डासुर – शून्यका ।
ब्रह्मोपेन्द्र – महेन्द्रादि – देव – संस्तुत – वैभवा ।।
items.tr:
kāmeśvarāsra – nirdagdha – sabhaṇḍāsura – śūnyakā |
brahmopendra – mahendrādi – deva – saṃstuta – vaibhavā ||
items.en: With the Kameshvara missile she burned Bhandasura together with his city Shunyaka (Kameshvarastra-nirdagdha-sabhandasura-shunyaka). Her glory is praised by Brahma, Vishnu, Indra and the other gods (Brahmopendra-mahendradi-deva-samstuta-vaibhava).

items.text:
हर- नेत्राग्रि – संदग्ध – काम – सञ्जीवनौषधिः ।
श्रीमद्वाग्भव – कूटैक – स्वरुप – मुख – पंक्कजा ।।
items.tr:
hara- netrāgri – saṃdagdha – kāma – sañjīvanauṣadhiḥ |
śrīmadvāgbhava – kūṭaika – svarupa – mukha – paṃkkajā ||
items.en: She is the life-giving herb that brought back Kama, who was burned by the fire of Shiva's eye (Hara-netragni-sandagdha-kama-sanjivanaushadhih). Her lotus face is the holy vagbhava part of her mantra (Shrimad-vagbhava-kutaika-svarupa-mukha-pankaja).

items.text:
कण्ठाधः – कटि – पर्यन्त – मध्यकूट – स्वरुपिणी ।
शक्तिकूटैकतापन्न – कट्यधोभाग – धारिणी ।।
items.tr:
kaṇṭhādhaḥ – kaṭi – paryanta – madhyakūṭa – svarupiṇī |
śaktikūṭaikatāpanna – kaṭyadhobhāga – dhāriṇī ||
items.en: Her body from below the neck to the waist is the middle part of the mantra (Kanthadhah-kati-paryanta-madhyakuta-svarupini). Her body below the waist is the shakti part (Shaktikutaikatapanna-katyadhobhaga-dharini).

items.text:
मूलमन्त्रात्मिका मूलकूटत्रय – कलेवरा ।
कुलामृतैक – रसिका – कुलसंकेत – पालिनी ।।
items.tr:
mūlamantrātmikā mūlakūṭatraya – kalevarā |
kulāmṛtaika – rasikā – kulasaṃketa – pālinī ||
items.en: She is the root mantra itself (Mulamantratmika) and her body is its three parts (Mulakutatraya-kalevara). She alone enjoys the nectar of the Kula path (Kulamritaika-rasika) and guards its secret rules (Kulasanketa-palini).

items.text:
कुलाङ्गना कुलान्तस्था कौलिनी कुलयोगिनी ।
अकुला समयान्तरस्था समयाचार – तत्परा ।।
items.tr:
kulāṅganā kulāntasthā kaulinī kulayoginī |
akulā samayāntarasthā samayācāra – tatparā ||
items.en: She is the noble lady of the Kula (Kulangana), dwells within the Kula (Kulantastha), and is Kaulini and Kulayogini. She is also beyond the Kula (Akula), lives within the Samaya path (Samayantastha), and is devoted to its practice (Samayachara-tatpara).

items.text:
मूलाधारैक – निलया ब्रह्माग्रन्थि – विभेदिनी ।
मणिपूरान्तरुदिता विष्णुग्रन्थि विभेदनी ।।
items.tr:
mūlādhāraika – nilayā brahmāgranthi – vibhedinī |
maṇipūrāntaruditā viṣṇugranthi vibhedanī ||
items.en: She lives in the Muladhara (Muladharaika-nilaya) and breaks the knot of Brahma (Brahmagranthi-vibhedini). She rises in the Manipura (Manipurantar-udita) and breaks the knot of Vishnu (Vishnugranthi-vibhedini).

items.text:
आज्ञाचक्रकान्तरालस्था रुद्रग्रन्थि – विभेदनी ।
सहस्राम्बुजारुढा सुधासाराभिवर्षिणी ।।
items.tr:
ājñācakrakāntarālasthā rudragranthi – vibhedanī |
sahasrāmbujāruḍhā sudhāsārābhivarṣiṇī ||
items.en: She stays in the Ajna chakra (Ajnachakrantaralastha) and breaks the knot of Rudra (Rudragranthi-vibhedini). She climbs to the thousand-petalled lotus (Sahasrarambujarudha) and pours down streams of nectar (Sudhasarabhivarshini).

items.text:
तडिलता समरुचिऋ षट्चक्रोपरि – संस्थिता ।
महाशक्तिः कुण्डलिनी बिसतन्तु – तनीयसी ।।
items.tr:
taḍilatā samaruciṛ ṣaṭcakropari – saṃsthitā |
mahāśaktiḥ kuṇḍalinī bisatantu – tanīyasī ||
items.en: She shines like a streak of lightning (Tadillata-samaruchih) and rests above the six chakras (Shatchakropari-samsthita). She is the great power (Mahashaktih), the coiled Kundalini, and as fine as a lotus fibre (Bisatantu-taniyasi).

items.text:
भवानी भावनागम्या भवारण्य – कुठारिका ।
भद्रप्रिया भद्रमूर्ति – भक्त- सौभाग्यदायिनी ।।
items.tr:
bhavānī bhāvanāgamyā bhavāraṇya – kuṭhārikā |
bhadrapriyā bhadramūrti – bhakta- saubhāgyadāyinī ||
items.en: She is Bhavani, reached through meditation (Bhavanagamya), and an axe for the forest of worldly life (Bhavaranya-kutharika). She loves what is good (Bhadrapriya), is goodness in form (Bhadramurti), and gives good fortune to devotees (Bhakta-saubhagyadayini).

items.text:
भक्तिप्रिया भक्तिगम्या भक्तिवश्या भयापहा ।
शाम्भवी शारदाराध्या शर्वाणी शर्मदायिनी ।।
items.tr:
bhaktipriyā bhaktigamyā bhaktivaśyā bhayāpahā |
śāmbhavī śāradārādhyā śarvāṇī śarmadāyinī ||
items.en: She loves devotion (Bhaktipriya), is reached by devotion (Bhaktigamya), is won by devotion (Bhaktivashya), and takes away fear (Bhayapaha). She is Shambhavi, worshipped by Sharada (Sharadaradhya), Sharvani, and the giver of happiness (Sharmadayini).

items.text:
शाक्करी श्रीकरी साध्वी शरचन्द्र – निभानना ।
शातोदरी शान्तिमती निराधारा निरञ्जना ।।
items.tr:
śākkarī śrīkarī sādhvī śaracandra – nibhānanā |
śātodarī śāntimatī nirādhārā nirañjanā ||
items.en: She is Shankari, the giver of wealth (Shrikari), the good woman (Sadhvi), with a face like the autumn moon (Sharachchandra-nibhanana). She is slender-waisted (Shatodari), full of peace (Shantimati), without support (Niradhara) and spotless (Niranjana).

items.text:
निर्लेपा निर्मला नित्या निराकारा निराकुला ।
निर्गुणा निष्कला शान्ता निष्कामा निरुपप्लवा ।।
items.tr:
nirlepā nirmalā nityā nirākārā nirākulā |
nirguṇā niṣkalā śāntā niṣkāmā nirupaplavā ||
items.en: She is untouched (Nirlepa), pure (Nirmala), eternal (Nitya), formless (Nirakara) and untroubled (Nirakula). She is beyond qualities (Nirguna), without parts (Nishkala), calm (Shanta), without desire (Nishkama) and free from harm (Nirupaplava).

items.text:
नित्यमुक्ता निर्विकारा निष्प्रपञ्जा निराश्रया ।
नित्यशुद्धा नित्यबुद्धा निरवद्या निरन्तरा ।।
items.tr:
nityamuktā nirvikārā niṣprapañjā nirāśrayā |
nityaśuddhā nityabuddhā niravadyā nirantarā ||
items.en: She is always free (Nityamukta), unchanging (Nirvikara), beyond the world (Nishprapancha) and needs no support (Nirashraya). She is ever pure (Nityashuddha), ever awake (Nityabuddha), faultless (Niravadya) and without break (Nirantara).

items.text:
निष्कारणा निष्कलङ्का निरुपाधि – र्निरीश्वरा ।
नीरागा रागथनी निर्मदा मदनाशिनी ।।
items.tr:
niṣkāraṇā niṣkalaṅkā nirupādhi – rnirīśvarā |
nīrāgā rāgathanī nirmadā madanāśinī ||
items.en: She has no cause (Nishkarana), no stain (Nishkalanka), no limit (Nirupadhi) and no lord above her (Nirishvara). She is free of attachment (Niraga) and destroys attachment (Ragamathani); she is free of pride (Nirmada) and destroys pride (Madanashini).

items.text:
निश्रिन्ता निरहङ्कारा निर्मोहा मोहनाशिनी ।
निमर्मा ममताहन्त्री निष्पापा पापनाशिनी ।।
items.tr:
niśrintā nirahaṅkārā nirmohā mohanāśinī |
nimarmā mamatāhantrī niṣpāpā pāpanāśinī ||
items.en: She is free of worry (Nishchinta), of ego (Nirahankara) and of delusion (Nirmoha), and she destroys delusion (Mohanashini). She has no sense of 'mine' (Nirmama) and removes it (Mamatahantri); she is sinless (Nishpapa) and destroys sin (Papanashini).

items.text:
निष्क्रोधा क्रोधशमनी निर्लोभा लोभनाषिनी ।
निःसंशया संशयघ्नी निर्भवा भवनाषिनी ।।
items.tr:
niṣkrodhā krodhaśamanī nirlobhā lobhanāṣinī |
niḥsaṃśayā saṃśayaghnī nirbhavā bhavanāṣinī ||
items.en: She is without anger (Nishkrodha) and calms anger (Krodhashamani); without greed (Nirlobha) and destroys greed (Lobhanashini). She is without doubt (Nihsamshaya) and kills doubt (Samshayaghni); she is without birth (Nirbhava) and ends the round of births (Bhavanashini).

items.text:
निर्विकल्पा निराबाधा निर्भेदा भेदनाशिनी ।
निर्नाशा मृत्युमथनी निष्क्रिया निष्परिग्रहा ।।
items.tr:
nirvikalpā nirābādhā nirbhedā bhedanāśinī |
nirnāśā mṛtyumathanī niṣkriyā niṣparigrahā ||
items.en: She is beyond all mental pictures (Nirvikalpa), without hindrance (Nirabadha), without division (Nirbheda), and removes division (Bhedanashini). She is imperishable (Nirnasha), destroys death (Mrityumathani), is beyond action (Nishkriya) and owns nothing (Nishparigraha).

items.text:
निस्तुला नीलचिकुरा निरपाया निरत्यया ।
दुर्लभा दुर्गमा दुर्गा दुःखहन्त्री सुखप्रदा ।।
items.tr:
nistulā nīlacikurā nirapāyā niratyayā |
durlabhā durgamā durgā duḥkhahantrī sukhapradā ||
items.en: She has no equal (Nistula), has dark hair (Nilachikura), is free of danger (Nirapaya) and cannot be passed beyond (Niratyaya). She is hard to win (Durlabha), hard to reach (Durgama), Durga, the remover of sorrow (Duhkhahantri) and the giver of happiness (Sukhaprada).

items.text:
दुष्टदूरा दुराचारशमनी दोष-वर्जिता ।
सर्वज्ञा सान्द्रकरुणा समानाधिक – वर्जिता ।।
items.tr:
duṣṭadūrā durācāraśamanī doṣa-varjitā |
sarvajñā sāndrakaruṇā samānādhika – varjitā ||
items.en: She is far from the wicked (Dushtadura), stops wrong conduct (Durachara-shamani), and has no fault (Doshavarjita). She knows everything (Sarvajna), is full of deep compassion (Sandrakaruna), and has no equal or superior (Samanadhika-varjita).

items.text:
सर्वशक्तिमयी सर्वमाङ्ग्ला सद्गति – प्रदा ।
सर्वेश्वरी सर्वमयी सर्वमन्त्र सर्वरुपिणी ।।
items.tr:
sarvaśaktimayī sarvamāṅglā sadgati – pradā |
sarveśvarī sarvamayī sarvamantra sarvarupiṇī ||
items.en: She holds all powers (Sarvashaktimayi), is fully auspicious (Sarvamangala), and gives the good path (Sadgatiprada). She is the ruler of all (Sarveshvari), she is everything (Sarvamayi), she is all mantras (Sarvamantrasvarupini) and all forms (Sarvarupini).

items.text:
सर्व – यन्त्रात्मिका सर्व – तन्त्ररुपा मनोन्मनी ।
माहेश्वरी महादेवी महालक्ष्मी – मृडप्रिया ।।
items.tr:
sarva – yantrātmikā sarva – tantrarupā manonmanī |
māheśvarī mahādevī mahālakṣmī – mṛḍapriyā ||
items.en: She is all yantras (Sarvayantratmika), all tantras (Sarvatantrarupa), and the state beyond the mind (Manonmani). She is Maheshvari, the great goddess (Mahadevi), Mahalakshmi, and the beloved of Shiva (Mridapriya).

items.text:
महारुपा महापूज्या महा – पातक-नाशिनी ।
महामाया महासत्वा महाशक्ति – र्मकारतिः ।।
items.tr:
mahārupā mahāpūjyā mahā – pātaka-nāśinī |
mahāmāyā mahāsatvā mahāśakti – rmakāratiḥ ||
items.en: She has a great form (Maharupa), is most worthy of worship (Mahapujya), and destroys great sins (Mahapataka-nashini). She is the great illusion (Mahamaya), great in goodness (Mahasattva), the great power (Mahashakti), and great joy (Maharati).

items.text:
महाभोगा महैश्वर्या महावीर्या महाबला ।
महाबुद्धि – महासिद्धि – र्महायोगेश्वरेश्वरी ।।
items.tr:
mahābhogā mahaiśvaryā mahāvīryā mahābalā |
mahābuddhi – mahāsiddhi – rmahāyogeśvareśvarī ||
items.en: She has great enjoyment (Mahabhoga), great lordship (Mahaishvarya), great valour (Mahavirya) and great strength (Mahabala). She has great wisdom (Mahabuddhi) and great powers (Mahasiddhi), and is the ruler of the lords of yoga (Mahayogeshvareshvari).

items.text:
महातन्त्रा – महामन्त्रा महायन्त्रा महासना ।
महायाग – महाक्रमाराध्या – महाभैरव – पूजिता ।
महेश्वर – महाकल्प –महाताण्डव – साक्षिणी ।
महाकामेश – महिषी महारात्रिपुरसुन्दरी ।।
items.tr:
mahātantrā – mahāmantrā mahāyantrā mahāsanā |
mahāyāga – mahākramārādhyā – mahābhairava – pūjitā |
maheśvara – mahākalpa –mahātāṇḍava – sākṣiṇī |
mahākāmeśa – mahiṣī mahārātripurasundarī ||
items.en: She is the great tantra (Mahatantra), the great mantra (Mahamantra), the great yantra (Mahayantra), and has a great seat (Mahasana). She is worshipped by the great rites (Mahayaga-kramaradhya) and by Mahabhairava (Mahabhairava-pujita). She is the witness of Shiva's great dance at the end of the great age (Maheshvara-mahakalpa-mahatandava-sakshini); she is the queen of Mahakameshvara (Mahakamesha-mahishi) and is Mahatripurasundari.

items.text:
चतुष्टषष्ट्युपचाराढ्या चतुष्टषष्टकलामयी ।
महाचतुःषष्टकोटि –योगिनी – गणसेवीता ।।
items.tr:
catuṣṭaṣaṣṭyupacārāḍhyā catuṣṭaṣaṣṭakalāmayī |
mahācatuḥṣaṣṭakoṭi –yoginī – gaṇasevītā ||
items.en: She is honoured with the sixty-four offerings (Chatuhshashtyupacharadhya) and holds the sixty-four arts (Chatuhshashtikalamayi). She is served by the great host of sixty-four crore yoginis (Mahachatuhshashtikoti-yogini-ganasevita).

items.text:
मनुविद्या चन्द्रविद्या चन्द्रमण्डल मध्यगा ।
चारुरुपा चारुहासा चारुचन्द्र – कलाधरा ।।
items.tr:
manuvidyā candravidyā candramaṇḍala madhyagā |
cārurupā cāruhāsā cārucandra – kalādharā ||
items.en: She is the Vidya of Manu (Manuvidya) and the Vidya of Chandra (Chandravidya), and lives in the centre of the moon's disc (Chandramandala-madhyaga). She has a lovely form (Charurupa), a lovely smile (Charuhasa), and wears a lovely crescent moon (Charuchandra-kaladhara).

items.text:
चराचर – जगन्नाथा चक्ररात – निकेतना ।
पार्वती पद्य्मनयना पद्य्मराग – समप्रभा ।।
items.tr:
carācara – jagannāthā cakrarāta – niketanā |
pārvatī padymanayanā padymarāga – samaprabhā ||
items.en: She is the ruler of all that moves and does not move (Characharajagannatha) and lives in the Shri Chakra (Chakraraja-niketana). She is Parvati, lotus-eyed (Padmanayana), and shines like a ruby (Padmaraga-samaprabha).

items.text:
पञ्चप्रेतासनासीना पञ्चब्रब्मस्वरुपिणी ।
चिरमयी परमानन्दा विज्ञानज्ञनस्वरुपिणी ।।
items.tr:
pañcapretāsanāsīnā pañcabrabmasvarupiṇī |
ciramayī paramānandā vijñānajñanasvarupiṇī ||
items.en: She sits on a seat of five lifeless forms (Panchapretasanasina) and is the five Brahmas (Panchabrahma-svarupini). She is pure consciousness (Chinmayi), supreme bliss (Paramananda), and knowledge itself (Vijnanaghana-rupini).

items.text:
ध्यान – ध्यातृ – ध्येयरुपा धर्माधर्मविवर्जिता ।
विश्वरुपा जागरणी स्वपन्ती तैजसात्मिका ।।
items.tr:
dhyāna – dhyātṛ – dhyeyarupā dharmādharmavivarjitā |
viśvarupā jāgaraṇī svapantī taijasātmikā ||
items.en: She is meditation, the one who meditates and the one meditated on (Dhyana-dhyatri-dhyeya-rupa), and she is beyond right and wrong (Dharmadharma-vivarjita). She is the universal form (Vishvarupa), the waking state (Jagarini), the dreaming state (Svapanti), and its inner light (Taijasatmika).

items.text:
सुप्ता प्राज्ञात्मिका तुर्या सर्वावस्था – विवर्जिता ।
सृष्टिकर्त्री ब्रह्मरुपा गोप्त्री गोविन्दरुपिणी ।।
items.tr:
suptā prājñātmikā turyā sarvāvasthā – vivarjitā |
sṛṣṭikartrī brahmarupā goptrī govindarupiṇī ||
items.en: She is deep sleep (Supta) and its knowing self (Prajnatmika), the fourth state (Turya), and beyond all states (Sarvavastha-vivarjita). She creates in the form of Brahma (Srishtikartri, Brahmarupa) and protects in the form of Govinda (Goptri, Govindarupini).

items.text:
संहारिणी रुद्ररुपा तिरोधानकरीश्वरी ।
सदाशिवाऽनुग्रहदा पञ्चकृत्यपरायणा ।।
items.tr:
saṃhāriṇī rudrarupā tirodhānakarīśvarī |
sadāśivā'nugrahadā pañcakṛtyaparāyaṇā ||
items.en: She destroys in the form of Rudra (Samharini, Rudrarupa), and as Ishvari she hides all things (Tirodhanakari). As Sadashiva she gives grace (Anugrahada); she is devoted to these five acts (Panchakritya-parayana).

items.text:
भानुमण्डल – मध्यस्था भैरवी भगमालिनी ।
पद्य्मासना भगवती पद्य्मनाभ – सहोदरी ।।
items.tr:
bhānumaṇḍala – madhyasthā bhairavī bhagamālinī |
padymāsanā bhagavatī padymanābha – sahodarī ||
items.en: She lives in the middle of the sun's disc (Bhanumandala-madhyastha) and is Bhairavi and Bhagamalini. She sits on a lotus (Padmasana), is Bhagavati, and is the sister of Vishnu (Padmanabha-sahodari).

items.text:
उन्मेष – निमिषोत्पन्न – विपन्न – भुवनावलिः ।
सहस्रशीर्षवदना सहस्राक्षी सहस्रपात् ।।
items.tr:
unmeṣa – nimiṣotpanna – vipanna – bhuvanāvaliḥ |
sahasraśīrṣavadanā sahasrākṣī sahasrapāt ||
items.en: Whole worlds arise and vanish as she opens and closes her eyes (Unmesha-nimishotpanna-vipanna-bhuvanavali). She has a thousand heads and faces (Sahasrashirshavadana), a thousand eyes (Sahasrakshi) and a thousand feet (Sahasrapat).

items.text:
आब्रह्मकीटजननी वर्णाश्रम विधायनी ।
निजाज्ञारुप – निगमा पुण्यापुण्य – फलप्रदा ।।
items.tr:
ābrahmakīṭajananī varṇāśrama vidhāyanī |
nijājñārupa – nigamā puṇyāpuṇya – phalapradā ||
items.en: She is the mother of all, from Brahma down to the worm (Abrahmakita-janani), and set up the order of social classes and stages of life (Varnashrama-vidhayini). The Vedas are her own command (Nijajnarupa-nigama), and she gives the fruits of good and bad deeds (Punyapunya-phalaprada).

items.text:
श्रुति सिमन्त सिन्दुरी – कृत – पादाब्जधूलिका ।
सकलागम सन्दोह – सूक्ति – सम्पुट – मौक्तिका ।।
items.tr:
śruti simanta sindurī – kṛta – pādābjadhūlikā |
sakalāgama sandoha – sūkti – sampuṭa – mauktikā ||
items.en: The dust of her lotus feet is the vermilion in the hair-parting of the Vedas (Shruti-simanta-sindurikrita-padabjadhulika). She is the pearl inside the shell made of all the scriptures (Sakalagama-sandoha-shukti-samputa-mauktika).

items.text:
पुरुषार्थ प्रदा पूर्णा भोगिनी भुवनेश्वरी ।
अम्बिकाऽनादि – निधना हरिब्रह्मेनदु सेविता ।।
items.tr:
puruṣārtha pradā pūrṇā bhoginī bhuvaneśvarī |
ambikā'nādi – nidhanā haribrahmenadu sevitā ||
items.en: She gives the goals of life (Purusharthaprada), is complete (Purna), enjoys all (Bhogini), and rules the worlds (Bhuvaneshvari). She is the Mother (Ambika), without beginning or end (Anadi-nidhana), and is served by Vishnu, Brahma and Indra (Haribrahmendra-sevita).

items.text:
नारायणी नादरुपा नामरुप – विवर्जिता ।
ह्रीं कारी ह्रीमती ह्रया हेयोपादेय वर्जिता ।।
items.tr:
nārāyaṇī nādarupā nāmarupa – vivarjitā |
hrīṃ kārī hrīmatī hrayā heyopādeya varjitā ||
items.en: She is Narayani, her form is sound (Nadarupa), and she is beyond name and form (Namarupa-vivarjita). She is the syllable Hrim (Hrimkari), modest (Hrimati), dear to the heart (Hridya), and beyond what is to be rejected or taken up (Heyopadeya-varjita).

items.text:
राजराजार्चिता राज्ञी रम्या राजीव लोचना ।
रञ्जनी रमणी रस्या रणत्किङ्किणी – मेखला ।।
items.tr:
rājarājārcitā rājñī ramyā rājīva locanā |
rañjanī ramaṇī rasyā raṇatkiṅkiṇī – mekhalā ||
items.en: She is worshipped by the king of kings (Rajarajarchita), is the Queen (Rajni), lovely (Ramya) and lotus-eyed (Rajivalochana). She gives delight (Ranjani), charms (Ramani), is full of sweetness (Rasya), and wears a girdle of ringing bells (Ranatkinkini-mekhala).

items.text:
रमा राकेन्दु – वदना रतिरुपा रतिप्रिया ।
रक्षाकरी राक्षसघ्नी रामा रमणलम्पटा ।।
items.tr:
ramā rākendu – vadanā ratirupā ratipriyā |
rakṣākarī rākṣasaghnī rāmā ramaṇalampaṭā ||
items.en: She is Rama (Lakshmi), with a face like the full moon (Rakenduvadana); she is Rati in form (Ratirupa) and loved by Rati (Ratipriya). She protects (Rakshakari), kills demons (Rakshasaghni), is lovely (Rama), and delights in her beloved (Ramanalampata).

items.text:
काम्या कामकलारुपा कदम्ब-कुसुम-प्रिया ।
कल्याणी जगती – कन्दा करुणा रस सागरा ।।
items.tr:
kāmyā kāmakalārupā kadamba-kusuma-priyā |
kalyāṇī jagatī – kandā karuṇā rasa sāgarā ||
items.en: She is desired by all (Kamya), the form of Kamakala (Kamakalarupa), and loves kadamba flowers (Kadambakusuma-priya). She is auspicious (Kalyani), the root of the world (Jagatikanda), and an ocean of compassion (Karunarasa-sagara).

items.text:
कलावती कलालापा कान्ता कादम्बरी – प्रिया ।
वरदा वामनयना वारुणी – मद – विह्वला ।।
items.tr:
kalāvatī kalālāpā kāntā kādambarī – priyā |
varadā vāmanayanā vāruṇī – mada – vihvalā ||
items.en: She is full of arts (Kalavati), sweet in speech (Kalalapa), beautiful (Kanta), and fond of the kadambari drink (Kadambari-priya). She grants boons (Varada), has lovely eyes (Vamanayana), and is overcome with the joy of varuni wine (Varunimada-vihvala).

items.text:
विश्वाशिका वेदवेद्या विन्ध्याचल – निवासनी ।
विधात्री वेदजननी विष्णुमाया विलासनी ।।
items.tr:
viśvāśikā vedavedyā vindhyācala – nivāsanī |
vidhātrī vedajananī viṣṇumāyā vilāsanī ||
items.en: She is above the universe (Vishvadhika), known through the Vedas (Vedavedya), and lives on the Vindhya mountains (Vindhyachala-nivasini). She is the creator (Vidhatri), mother of the Vedas (Vedajanani), Vishnu's power of illusion (Vishnumaya), and full of play (Vilasini).

items.text:
क्षेत्रस्वरुपा क्षेत्रेशी क्षेत्र – क्षेत्र्यज्ञ – पालिनी ।
क्षयवृद्धि – विर्निमुक्ता क्षेत्रपाल – समर्जिता ।।
items.tr:
kṣetrasvarupā kṣetreśī kṣetra – kṣetryajña – pālinī |
kṣayavṛddhi – virnimuktā kṣetrapāla – samarjitā ||
items.en: She is the body, the field (Kshetrasvarupa), the ruler of the field (Kshetreshi), and protects both the field and its knower (Kshetra-kshetrajna-palini). She is free from loss and gain (Kshayavriddhi-vinirmukta) and is worshipped by the guardians of the field (Kshetrapala-samarchita).

items.text:
विजया विमला वन्ध्या वन्दारु –जन-वत्सला ।
वाग्वादिनी वामकेशी वह्मिमण्डल वासिनी ।।
items.tr:
vijayā vimalā vandhyā vandāru –jana-vatsalā |
vāgvādinī vāmakeśī vahmimaṇḍala vāsinī ||
items.en: She is victorious (Vijaya), pure (Vimala), worthy of worship (Vandya), and loving to those who bow to her (Vandarujana-vatsala). She is the goddess of speech (Vagvadini), has beautiful hair (Vamakeshi), and lives in the circle of fire (Vahnimandala-vasini).

items.text:
भक्तिमय कल्पलतिका पशुपाश – विमोचनी ।
संह्रताशेष – पाषण्डा सदाचार – प्रवर्तिका ।।
items.tr:
bhaktimaya kalpalatikā paśupāśa – vimocanī |
saṃhratāśeṣa – pāṣaṇḍā sadācāra – pravartikā ||
items.en: She is a wish-granting creeper for the devoted (Bhaktimat-kalpalatika) and frees bound souls from their bonds (Pashupasha-vimochini). She destroys all false teachings (Samhritashesha-pashanda) and spreads good conduct (Sadachara-pravartika).

items.text:
तापत्रयाग्रि – सन्तप्त – समाह्वदन – चन्द्रिका ।
तरुणी तापसा राध्या तनुमध्या तमोऽपहा ।।
items.tr:
tāpatrayāgri – santapta – samāhvadana – candrikā |
taruṇī tāpasā rādhyā tanumadhyā tamo'pahā ||
items.en: She is moonlight that cools those burned by the fire of the three kinds of suffering (Tapatrayagni-santapta-samahladana-chandrika). She is young (Taruni), worshipped by ascetics (Tapasaradhya), slender-waisted (Tanumadhya), and removes darkness (Tamopaha).

items.text:
चिति – स्ततपद – लक्ष्यार्थी चिदेकरस – रुपिणी ।
स्वात्मानन्द लयाभूत – ब्रह्माद्यानन्द – सन्तति ।।
items.tr:
citi – statapada – lakṣyārthī cidekarasa – rupiṇī |
svātmānanda layābhūta – brahmādyānanda – santati ||
items.en: She is the true meaning of the words 'chit' and 'tat' (Chitistatpada-lakshyartha) and is pure consciousness alone (Chidekarasa-rupini). The bliss of Brahma and the other gods is only a drop of her own bliss (Svatmananda-lavibhuta-brahmadyananda-santatih).

items.text:
परा प्रत्यक चित्तरुपा पश्यन्ती परदेवता ।
मध्यमा वैखरी रुपा भक्तृमानस – हंसिका ।।
items.tr:
parā pratyaka cittarupā paśyantī paradevatā |
madhyamā vaikharī rupā bhaktṛmānasa – haṃsikā ||
items.en: She is Para, the highest level of speech, and the inner consciousness (Pratyak-chitirupa); she is Pashyanti, the supreme deity (Paradevata), Madhyama and Vaikhari (Vaikharirupa). She is the swan in the minds of her devotees (Bhaktamanasa-hamsika).

items.text:
कामेश्वर – प्राणनाडी कृतज्ञा कामपूजिता ।
श्रृंगार रस- सम्पूर्णा जया जालन्धर स्थिता ।।
items.tr:
kāmeśvara – prāṇanāḍī kṛtajñā kāmapūjitā |
śrṛṃgāra rasa- sampūrṇā jayā jālandhara sthitā ||
items.en: She is the life-breath of Kameshvara (Kameshvara-prananadi), grateful (Kritajna), and worshipped by Kama (Kamapujita). She is full of the feeling of love (Shringara-rasa-sampurna), victorious (Jaya), and dwells in Jalandhara (Jalandhara-sthita).

items.text:
ओड्यपाण-पीठ – विलया बिन्दु – माण्डलवासिनी ।
रहायोग – क्रमाराध्या रहस्तपर्ण – तर्पिता ।।
items.tr:
oḍyapāṇa-pīṭha – vilayā bindu – māṇḍalavāsinī |
rahāyoga – kramārādhyā rahastaparṇa – tarpitā ||
items.en: She lives in the holy seat of Odyana (Odyanapitha-nilaya) and in the circle of the bindu (Bindumandala-vasini). She is worshipped by secret rites (Rahoyoga-kramaradhya) and pleased by secret offerings (Rahastarpana-tarpita).

items.text:
सद्यः प्रसादिनी विश्वसाक्षिणी साक्षिवर्जिता ।
षडङ्गदेवता – युक्ता षाड्गुण्य – परिपूरिता ।।
items.tr:
sadyaḥ prasādinī viśvasākṣiṇī sākṣivarjitā |
ṣaḍaṅgadevatā – yuktā ṣāḍguṇya – paripūritā ||
items.en: She gives grace at once (Sadyahprasadini), is the witness of the universe (Vishvasakshini), and has no witness over her (Sakshivarjita). She is joined by the deities of the six limbs (Shadangadevata-yukta) and is full of the six divine virtues (Shadgunya-paripurita).

items.text:
नित्या – क्लिन्ना निरुपमा निर्वाण सुख दायिनी ।
नित्याषोडशिका – रुपा श्रीकण्ठार्ध – शरीरिणी ।।
items.tr:
nityā – klinnā nirupamā nirvāṇa sukha dāyinī |
nityāṣoḍaśikā – rupā śrīkaṇṭhārdha – śarīriṇī ||
items.en: She is ever tender with mercy (Nityaklinna), beyond compare (Nirupama), and gives the joy of liberation (Nirvanasukha-dayini). She is the sixteen Nitya goddesses (Nityashodashika-rupa) and is half of Shiva's body (Shrikantardha-sharirini).

items.text:
प्रभावती प्रभारुपा प्रसिद्धा परमेश्वरी ।
मूलप्रकृति – रव्यक्ता व्यक्ताव्यक्त – स्वरुपिणी ।।
items.tr:
prabhāvatī prabhārupā prasiddhā parameśvarī |
mūlaprakṛti – ravyaktā vyaktāvyakta – svarupiṇī ||
items.en: She is radiant (Prabhavati), light itself (Prabharupa), well known (Prasiddha), and the supreme ruler (Parameshvari). She is the root of nature (Mulaprakriti), the unmanifest (Avyakta), and both manifest and unmanifest (Vyaktavyakta-svarupini).

items.text:
व्यापिनी विविधाकारा विद्याऽविद्या – स्वरुपिणी ।
महाकामेश नयन-कुमुदाह्वाद – कौमुदी ।।
items.tr:
vyāpinī vividhākārā vidyā'vidyā – svarupiṇī |
mahākāmeśa nayana-kumudāhvāda – kaumudī ||
items.en: She is present everywhere (Vyapini), has many forms (Vividhakara), and is both knowledge and ignorance (Vidyavidya-svarupini). She is the moonlight that makes the lily-like eyes of Mahakameshvara bloom (Mahakamesha-nayana-kumudahlada-kaumudi).

items.text:
'भक्त –हार्द – तमो – भेद – मद्भानु संततिः ।
शिवदूती शिवराध्या शिवमूर्तिः शिवक्करि ।।
items.tr:
'bhakta –hārda – tamo – bheda – madbhānu saṃtatiḥ |
śivadūtī śivarādhyā śivamūrtiḥ śivakkari ||
items.en: She is a line of rising suns that breaks the darkness in her devotees' hearts (Bhaktahardatamobheda-bhanumad-bhanu-santatih). She sent Shiva as her messenger (Shivaduti), is worshipped by Shiva (Shivaradhya), has Shiva's form (Shivamurti), and brings good (Shivankari).

items.text:
शिवप्रिया शिवपरा शिष्टेष्टा शिष्टपूजिता ।
अप्रमेया स्वप्रकाशा मनो-वाचामगोचरा ।।
items.tr:
śivapriyā śivaparā śiṣṭeṣṭā śiṣṭapūjitā |
aprameyā svaprakāśā mano-vācāmagocarā ||
items.en: She is dear to Shiva (Shivapriya), devoted to Shiva (Shivapara), loved by the good (Shishteshta), and worshipped by the good (Shishtapujita). She is beyond measure (Aprameya), shines by her own light (Svaprakasha), and is beyond mind and speech (Manovachamagochara).

items.text:
च्छिछक्ति – श्चेतना – रुपा जडशक्ति – र्जडात्मिका ।
गायत्री – व्याह्रती संध्या द्विजबृन्द – निषेविता ।।
items.tr:
cchichakti – ścetanā – rupā jaḍaśakti – rjaḍātmikā |
gāyatrī – vyāhratī saṃdhyā dvijabṛnda – niṣevitā ||
items.en: She is the power of consciousness (Chichchhakti), awareness itself (Chetanarupa), the power in matter (Jadashakti), and matter itself (Jadatmika). She is Gayatri, the sacred utterances (Vyahriti), the twilight prayer (Sandhya), and is served by the twice-born (Dvijabrinda-nishevita).

items.text:
तत्वासना तत्तवमयी पञ्चकोशान्तर – स्थिता ।
निःसीम – महिमा नित्य – यौवना मदशालिनी ।।
items.tr:
tatvāsanā tattavamayī pañcakośāntara – sthitā |
niḥsīma – mahimā nitya – yauvanā madaśālinī ||
items.en: The principles of creation are her seat (Tattvasana), she is made of them (Tattvamayi), and she lives within the five sheaths (Panchakoshantara-sthita). Her greatness has no limit (Nihsimamahima); she is ever young (Nityayauvana) and full of joyful rapture (Madashalini).

items.text:
मद्घूर्णित रक्ताक्षी मदपाट्ल-गण्डभूः ।
चन्दन – द्रव – दिग्धाङ्की चाम्पेय –कुसुम – प्रिया ।।
items.tr:
madghūrṇita raktākṣī madapāṭla-gaṇḍabhūḥ |
candana – drava – digdhāṅkī cāmpeya –kusuma – priyā ||
items.en: Her eyes are red and rolling with rapture (Madaghurnita-raktakshi) and her cheeks are flushed (Madapatala-gandabhuh). Her body is smeared with sandal paste (Chandanadrava-digdhangi) and she loves champaka flowers (Champeya-kusuma-priya).

items.text:
कुशला कोमलाकारा कुरुकुल्ला कुलेश्वरी ।
कुलकुण्डलया कौलमार्ग – तत्पर – सेविता ।।
items.tr:
kuśalā komalākārā kurukullā kuleśvarī |
kulakuṇḍalayā kaulamārga – tatpara – sevitā ||
items.en: She is skilful (Kushala), gentle in form (Komalakara), is Kurukulla, and rules the Kula (Kuleshvari). She lives in the Kulakunda (Kulakundalaya) and is served by those devoted to the Kaula path (Kaulamarga-tatpara-sevita).

items.text:
कुमार – गणनाशाम्बा तुष्टिः पुष्टि-र्मति-धृतिः ।
शान्तिः स्वस्तिमयी कान्ति-र्नन्दिनी विघ्ननाशिनी ।।
items.tr:
kumāra – gaṇanāśāmbā tuṣṭiḥ puṣṭi-rmati-dhṛtiḥ |
śāntiḥ svastimayī kānti-rnandinī vighnanāśinī ||
items.en: She is the mother of Kumara and Ganesha (Kumara-gananathamba), and she is contentment (Tushti), nourishment (Pushti), understanding (Mati) and steadiness (Dhriti). She is peace (Shanti), well-being (Svastimati), beauty (Kanti), joy (Nandini), and destroys obstacles (Vighnanashini).

items.text:
तेजोवती त्रिनयना लोलाक्षी – कामरुपिणी ।
मालिनी हंसिनी माता मलयाचल – वासिनी ।।
items.tr:
tejovatī trinayanā lolākṣī – kāmarupiṇī |
mālinī haṃsinī mātā malayācala – vāsinī ||
items.en: She is full of light (Tejovati), three-eyed (Trinayana), has restless eyes (Lolakshi), and takes any form she wishes (Kamarupini). She wears garlands (Malini), is Hamsini, the Mother (Mata), and lives on the Malaya mountain (Malayachala-vasini).

items.text:
सुमुखी नलिनी सुभ्रूः शोभना सुरनायिका ।
कालकण्ठी कान्तिमयी क्षोभिणी सूक्ष्मरुपिणी ।।
items.tr:
sumukhī nalinī subhrūḥ śobhanā suranāyikā |
kālakaṇṭhī kāntimayī kṣobhiṇī sūkṣmarupiṇī ||
items.en: She has a lovely face (Sumukhi), is soft like a lotus (Nalini), has fine eyebrows (Subhru), is beautiful (Shobhana), and leads the gods (Suranayika). She is Kalakanthi, full of radiance (Kantimati), stirs creation into motion (Kshobhini), and has a subtle form (Sukshmarupini).

items.text:
वज्रेश्वरी वामदेवी वयोवस्था – विवर्जिता ।
सिद्धेश्वरी सिद्धविद्या सिद्धमाता यशस्वनी ।।
items.tr:
vajreśvarī vāmadevī vayovasthā – vivarjitā |
siddheśvarī siddhavidyā siddhamātā yaśasvanī ||
items.en: She is Vajreshvari and Vamadevi, and she is untouched by age (Vayovastha-vivarjita). She is the queen of the perfected ones (Siddheshvari), their knowledge (Siddhavidya), their mother (Siddhamata), and is famous (Yashasvini).

items.text:
विशुद्धि – चक्र – निलया - ऽऽरक्तवर्णा त्रिलोचना ।
खट्वाङ्गदि – प्रहरणा वदवैक – समन्विता ।।
items.tr:
viśuddhi – cakra – nilayā - ''raktavarṇā trilocanā |
khaṭvāṅgadi – praharaṇā vadavaika – samanvitā ||
items.en: She lives in the Vishuddhi chakra (Vishuddhichakra-nilaya), is reddish in colour (Araktavarna) and three-eyed (Trilochana). She holds the khatvanga staff and other weapons (Khatvangadi-praharana) and has one face (Vadanaika-samanvita).

items.text:
पायसान्न प्रिया त्वकस्था पशुलोक भयंक्करी ।
अमृतादि – महाशक्ति –संवृता डाकिनीश्वरी ।।
items.tr:
pāyasānna priyā tvakasthā paśuloka bhayaṃkkarī |
amṛtādi – mahāśakti –saṃvṛtā ḍākinīśvarī ||
items.en: She loves sweet rice pudding (Payasanna-priya), dwells in the skin (Tvakstha), and frightens those of animal nature (Pashuloka-bhayankari). She is surrounded by Amrita and other great powers (Amritadi-mahashakti-samvrita) and is Dakini, their queen (Dakinishvari).

items.text:
अनाहाताब्ज – निलया श्यामाभा वदनद्वया ।
दंष्ट्रोज्ज्वलाक्षमालादि – धरा रुधिर – संस्थिता ।।
items.tr:
anāhātābja – nilayā śyāmābhā vadanadvayā |
daṃṣṭrojjvalākṣamālādi – dharā rudhira – saṃsthitā ||
items.en: She lives in the Anahata lotus (Anahatabja-nilaya), is dark in colour (Shyamabha), and has two faces (Vadanadvaya). She shines with her tusks, holds a rosary and other things (Damshtrojjvalakshamaladi-dhara), and dwells in the blood (Rudhira-samsthita).

items.text:
कालरात्र्यादि – शक्त्यौघ – वृता स्न्गिधौदन – प्रिया ।
महावीरेन्द्र वरदा राकिण्यम्बा – स्वरुपिणी ।।
items.tr:
kālarātryādi – śaktyaugha – vṛtā sngidhaudana – priyā |
mahāvīrendra varadā rākiṇyambā – svarupiṇī ||
items.en: She is surrounded by Kalaratri and other powers (Kalaratryadi-shaktyaugha-vrita) and loves rice cooked with ghee (Snigdhaudana-priya). She grants boons to great heroes (Mahavirendra-varada) and is Rakini the Mother (Rakinyamba-svarupini).

items.text:
मणिपूराब्ज निलया वदहत्रय – संयुता ।
वज्राधिकायुधोपेता डामर्यादिभि – रावृता ।।
items.tr:
maṇipūrābja nilayā vadahatraya – saṃyutā |
vajrādhikāyudhopetā ḍāmaryādibhi – rāvṛtā ||
items.en: She lives in the Manipura lotus (Manipurabja-nilaya) and has three faces (Vadanatraya-samyuta). She holds the thunderbolt and other weapons (Vajradikayudhopeta) and is surrounded by Damari and other powers (Damaryadibhir-avrita).

items.text:
रक्तिवर्णा मांसनिष्ठा गुडान्न – प्रीत – मानसा ।
समस्तभक्त – सुखदा लाकिन्यम्बा – स्वरुपिणी ।।
items.tr:
raktivarṇā māṃsaniṣṭhā guḍānna – prīta – mānasā |
samastabhakta – sukhadā lākinyambā – svarupiṇī ||
items.en: She is red in colour (Raktavarna), dwells in the flesh (Mamsanishtha), and loves rice with jaggery (Gudanna-prita-manasa). She gives joy to all devotees (Samastabhakta-sukhada) and is Lakini the Mother (Lakinyamba-svarupini).

items.text:
स्वाधिष्ठानाम्बुजकता चर्तुवक्त्र – मनोहरा ।
शूलाद्यायुद्ध – सम्पन्ना पीतवर्णाऽतिगर्विता ।।
items.tr:
svādhiṣṭhānāmbujakatā cartuvaktra – manoharā |
śūlādyāyuddha – sampannā pītavarṇā'tigarvitā ||
items.en: She lives in the Svadhishthana lotus (Svadhishthanambujagata) and is lovely with four faces (Chaturvaktra-manohara). She holds the trident and other weapons (Shuladyayudha-sampanna), is yellow in colour (Pitavarna), and very proud (Atigarvita).

items.text:
मेदो निष्ठा मधुप्रीता बन्धिन्यादि – समन्विता ।
दध्यन्नासक्त – ह्रदया काकिनी – रुप – धारिणी ।।
items.tr:
medo niṣṭhā madhuprītā bandhinyādi – samanvitā |
dadhyannāsakta – hradayā kākinī – rupa – dhāriṇī ||
items.en: She dwells in the fat of the body (Medonishtha), loves honey (Madhuprita), and is joined by Bandhini and other powers (Bandhinyadi-samanvita). She loves curd rice (Dadhyannasakta-hridaya) and takes the form of Kakini (Kakinirupa-dharini).

items.text:
मूलाधाराम्बुजारुढा पञ्चवक्त्रास्थि – संस्थिता ।
अङ्कुशादि –प्रहरणा वरदादि – निषेविता ।।
items.tr:
mūlādhārāmbujāruḍhā pañcavaktrāsthi – saṃsthitā |
aṅkuśādi –praharaṇā varadādi – niṣevitā ||
items.en: She sits in the Muladhara lotus (Muladharambujarudha), has five faces (Panchavaktra), and dwells in the bones (Asthisamsthita). She holds the goad and other weapons (Ankushadi-praharana) and is served by Varada and other powers (Varadadi-nishevita).

items.text:
मुद्गौदनासक्त – चित्ता साकिन्यम्बा – स्वरुपिणी ।
आज्ञा – चक्राब्ज – निलया शुक्लवर्णा षडानना ।।
items.tr:
mudgaudanāsakta – cittā sākinyambā – svarupiṇī |
ājñā – cakrābja – nilayā śuklavarṇā ṣaḍānanā ||
items.en: She loves rice cooked with green gram (Mudgaudanasakta-chitta) and is Sakini the Mother (Sakinyamba-svarupini). She lives in the Ajna chakra lotus (Ajnachakrabja-nilaya), is white (Shuklavarna), and has six faces (Shadanana).

items.text:
मज्जा – संस्था हंसवती – मुख्य – शक्ति – समान्विता ।
हरिद्रान्नैक – रसिका हाकिनी – रुप – धारिणी ।।
items.tr:
majjā – saṃsthā haṃsavatī – mukhya – śakti – samānvitā |
haridrānnaika – rasikā hākinī – rupa – dhāriṇī ||
items.en: She dwells in the marrow (Majjasamstha) and is joined by Hamsavati and other chief powers (Hamsavati-mukhyashakti-samanvita). She loves rice cooked with turmeric (Haridrannaika-rasika) and takes the form of Hakini (Hakinirupa-dharini).

items.text:
सहस्रदल – पद्य्मस्था सर्व – वर्णोप – शोभिता ।
सर्वायुध – धरा शुक्ल – संस्थिता सर्वतोमुखी ।।
items.tr:
sahasradala – padymasthā sarva – varṇopa – śobhitā |
sarvāyudha – dharā śukla – saṃsthitā sarvatomukhī ||
items.en: She lives in the thousand-petalled lotus (Sahasradala-padmastha) and shines with every colour (Sarvavarnopa-shobhita). She holds every weapon (Sarvayudhadhara), dwells in the vital seed (Shukla-samsthita), and faces every direction (Sarvatomukhi).

items.text:
सर्वौदन- प्रीतचित्ता याकिन्यम्बा – स्वरुपिणी ।
स्वाहा स्वधाऽमति – र्मेधा श्रुति- स्मृति- रन्नुमत्ता ।।
items.tr:
sarvaudana- prītacittā yākinyambā – svarupiṇī |
svāhā svadhā'mati – rmedhā śruti- smṛti- rannumattā ||
items.en: She is pleased with every kind of food (Sarvaudana-pritachitta) and is Yakini the Mother (Yakinyamba-svarupini). She is Svaha and Svadha, beyond thought (Amati), intelligence (Medha), the Vedas (Shruti), the law books (Smriti), and the highest (Anuttama).

items.text:
पुण्यकीर्तिः पुण्यलभ्या पुण्यश्रवण – कीर्तिना ।
पुलोमजार्चिता बन्धमोचनी बन्धुरालका ।।
items.tr:
puṇyakīrtiḥ puṇyalabhyā puṇyaśravaṇa – kīrtinā |
pulomajārcitā bandhamocanī bandhurālakā ||
items.en: Her fame is holy (Punyakirti), she is reached through good deeds (Punyalabhya), and to hear and praise her is holy (Punyashravana-kirtana). She is worshipped by Indra's wife (Pulomajarchita), frees from bondage (Bandhamochani), and has lovely curling hair (Bandhuralaka).

items.text:
विमर्शरुपिणी विद्या वियदादि – जगत्प्रसूः ।
सर्वव्याधि – प्रशमनी सर्वमृत्यु – निवारणी ।।
items.tr:
vimarśarupiṇī vidyā viyadādi – jagatprasūḥ |
sarvavyādhi – praśamanī sarvamṛtyu – nivāraṇī ||
items.en: She is the power of self-awareness (Vimarsharupini), knowledge (Vidya), and the mother of the world, starting with space (Viyadadi-jagatprasuh). She cures all diseases (Sarvavyadhi-prashamani) and keeps away every kind of death (Sarvamrityu-nivarini).

items.text:
अग्रगण्या - ऽचिन्त्यरुपा कलिकल्मष – नाशिनी ।
कात्यायनी कालहन्त्री कमलाक्ष – निषेविता ।।
items.tr:
agragaṇyā - 'cintyarupā kalikalmaṣa – nāśinī |
kātyāyanī kālahantrī kamalākṣa – niṣevitā ||
items.en: She is the first of all (Agraganya), her form is beyond thought (Achintyarupa), and she destroys the sins of the Kali age (Kalikalmasha-nashini). She is Katyayani, she destroys time (Kalahantri), and is worshipped by the lotus-eyed Vishnu (Kamalaksha-nishevita).

items.text:
ताम्बूल – पूरित – मुखी दाडिमी –कुसुम – प्रभा ।
मृगाक्षी मोहिनी मुख्या मृडानी मित्ररुपिणी ।।
items.tr:
tāmbūla – pūrita – mukhī dāḍimī –kusuma – prabhā |
mṛgākṣī mohinī mukhyā mṛḍānī mitrarupiṇī ||
items.en: Her mouth is full of betel (Tambulapurita-mukhi) and she glows like a pomegranate flower (Dadimikusuma-prabha). She is doe-eyed (Mrigakshi), enchanting (Mohini), the chief one (Mukhya), the wife of Shiva (Mridani), and a friend to all (Mitrarupini).

items.text:
नित्य – तृप्ता भक्तिनिधि – र्नियन्त्री निखिलेश्वरी ।
मैत्र्यादि – वासनालभ्या महा-प्रलय-साक्षिणी ।।
items.tr:
nitya – tṛptā bhaktinidhi – rniyantrī nikhileśvarī |
maitryādi – vāsanālabhyā mahā-pralaya-sākṣiṇī ||
items.en: She is ever content (Nityatripta), a treasure for her devotees (Bhaktanidhi), the controller (Niyantri), and the ruler of all (Nikhileshvari). She is reached through friendliness and other good feelings (Maitryadi-vasanalabhya) and is the witness of the great dissolution (Mahapralaya-sakshini).

items.text:
पराशक्तिः परानिष्ठा प्रज्ञानघन – रुपिणी ।
माध्वीपानालसा मत्ता मातृका – वर्ण-रुपिणी ।।
items.tr:
parāśaktiḥ parāniṣṭhā prajñānaghana – rupiṇī |
mādhvīpānālasā mattā mātṛkā – varṇa-rupiṇī ||
items.en: She is the highest power (Parashakti), the highest goal (Paranishtha), and pure knowledge in form (Prajnanaghana-rupini). She is languid from drinking sweet wine (Madhvipanalasa), rapt (Matta), and her form is the letters of the alphabet (Matrikavarna-rupini).

items.text:
महाकैलास-निलया – मृणाल-मृदु-दोर्लता ।
महनीया दयामूर्ति – र्महासाम्राज्य-शालिनी ।।
items.tr:
mahākailāsa-nilayā – mṛṇāla-mṛdu-dorlatā |
mahanīyā dayāmūrti – rmahāsāmrājya-śālinī ||
items.en: She lives on great Kailasa (Mahakailasa-nilaya) and her arms are soft as lotus stems (Mrinala-mridu-dorlata). She is worthy of honour (Mahaniya), mercy in form (Dayamurti), and rules a great empire (Mahasamrajya-shalini).

items.text:
आत्मविद्या महाविद्या श्रीविद्या कामसेविता ।
श्रीषोडाशाक्षरीविद्या त्रिकुटा कामकोटिका ।।
items.tr:
ātmavidyā mahāvidyā śrīvidyā kāmasevitā |
śrīṣoḍāśākṣarīvidyā trikuṭā kāmakoṭikā ||
items.en: She is knowledge of the Self (Atmavidya), the great knowledge (Mahavidya), Shri Vidya, and is served by Kama (Kamasevita). She is the sixteen-syllable mantra (Shrishodashakshari-vidya), has three parts (Trikuta), and dwells in Kamakoti (Kamakotika).

items.text:
कटाक्ष – किंक्करी-भूत – कमला – कोटि – सेविता ।
शिरःस्थिता चन्द्रनिभा भालस्थेन्द्रु – धनुः प्रभा ।।
items.tr:
kaṭākṣa – kiṃkkarī-bhūta – kamalā – koṭi – sevitā |
śiraḥsthitā candranibhā bhālasthendru – dhanuḥ prabhā ||
items.en: She is served by millions of Lakshmis who wait on her glance like servants (Kataksha-kinkari-bhuta-kamala-koti-sevita). She sits in the head, shining like the moon (Shirahsthita, Chandranibha), and in the forehead, glowing like a rainbow (Bhalastha, Indradhanuh-prabha).

items.text:
ह्दयास्था रविप्रख्या त्रिकोणान्तर – दीपिका ।
दाक्षायणी दैन्त्यहन्त्री दक्षयज्ञविनाशनी ।।
items.tr:
hdayāsthā raviprakhyā trikoṇāntara – dīpikā |
dākṣāyaṇī daintyahantrī dakṣayajñavināśanī ||
items.en: She dwells in the heart, shining like the sun (Hridayastha, Raviprakhya), and is the lamp inside the triangle (Trikonantara-dipika). She is Dakshayani, kills demons (Daityahantri), and destroyed Daksha's sacrifice (Dakshayajna-vinashini).

items.text:
दरान्दोलित दीर्घाक्षी दरहासोज्ज्वलमुखी ।
गुरु-मूर्ति-गुण-निधि-र्गोमाता गुहजन्म – भूः ।।
items.tr:
darāndolita dīrghākṣī darahāsojjvalamukhī |
guru-mūrti-guṇa-nidhi-rgomātā guhajanma – bhūḥ ||
items.en: Her long eyes move gently (Darandolita-dirghakshi) and her face glows with a soft smile (Darahasojjvala-mukhi). She is the guru in form (Gurumurti), a treasure of virtues (Gunanidhi), the mother of cows (Gomata), and the mother of Guha (Guhajanmabhuh).

items.text:
देवेशी दण्डनीतिस्था दहराकाश – रुपिणी ।
प्रतिपन्मुख्य – राकान्त –तिथि-मण्डल – पूजिता ।।
items.tr:
deveśī daṇḍanītisthā daharākāśa – rupiṇī |
pratipanmukhya – rākānta –tithi-maṇḍala – pūjitā ||
items.en: She is the queen of the gods (Deveshi), upholds just rule (Dandanitistha), and is the small space within the heart (Daharakasha-rupini). She is worshipped on each lunar day, from the first to the full moon (Pratipan-mukhya-rakanta-tithi-mandala-pujita).

items.text:
कलात्मिका कलानाथा काव्यालाप – विनोदनी ।
सचामर – रमा – वाणी – सव्य – दक्षिण – सेविता ।।
items.tr:
kalātmikā kalānāthā kāvyālāpa – vinodanī |
sacāmara – ramā – vāṇī – savya – dakṣiṇa – sevitā ||
items.en: She is the arts in form (Kalatmika), the lord of the arts (Kalanatha), and enjoys poetry (Kavyalapa-vinodini). Lakshmi and Sarasvati attend her on the left and right, holding fans (Sachamara-rama-vani-savya-dakshina-sevita).

items.text:
आदिशक्ति - रमेयाऽऽत्मा परमा पावनाकृतिः ।
अनेक –कोटि-ब्रह्माण्ड-जननी दिव्य-विग्रहा ।।
items.tr:
ādiśakti - rameyā''tmā paramā pāvanākṛtiḥ |
aneka –koṭi-brahmāṇḍa-jananī divya-vigrahā ||
items.en: She is the first power (Adishakti), beyond measure (Ameya), the Self (Atma), supreme (Parama), and pure in form (Pavanakritih). She is the mother of countless millions of universes (Anekakoti-brahmanda-janani) and has a divine body (Divyavigraha).

items.text:
क्लीं कारी केवला गुह्या कैवल्य-पद-दायिनी ।
त्रिपुरा त्रिजगद्वन्द्या त्रिमूर्ति-स्रिदशेश्वरी ।
त्र्यक्षरी दिव्य – गन्धाढ्या सिन्दुर-तिलकाञ्जिता ।
उमा शैलेन्द्रतनया गौरी गन्धर्व – सेविता ।।
items.tr:
klīṃ kārī kevalā guhyā kaivalya-pada-dāyinī |
tripurā trijagadvandyā trimūrti-sridaśeśvarī |
tryakṣarī divya – gandhāḍhyā sindura-tilakāñjitā |
umā śailendratanayā gaurī gandharva – sevitā ||
items.en: She is the syllable Klim (Klimkari), the only one (Kevala), the secret one (Guhya), and gives final freedom (Kaivalya-pada-dayini). She is Tripura, worshipped in the three worlds (Trijagadvandya), the three gods in one (Trimurti), the queen of the gods (Tridasheshvari), the three-syllable mantra (Tryakshari), rich with divine fragrance (Divyagandhadhya), and marked with a vermilion dot (Sindura-tilakanchita). She is Uma, daughter of the king of mountains (Shailendratanaya), Gauri, and is served by the Gandharvas (Gandharva-sevita).

items.text:
विश्वगर्भा स्वर्णगर्भा - ऽवरदा वागधीश्वरी ।
ध्यानगम्या - ऽपरिच्छेद्या ज्ञानदा ज्ञानविग्रहा ।।
items.tr:
viśvagarbhā svarṇagarbhā - 'varadā vāgadhīśvarī |
dhyānagamyā - 'paricchedyā jñānadā jñānavigrahā ||
items.en: The universe lies in her womb (Vishvagarbha); she holds the golden womb (Svarnagarbha), she is Avarada, and she rules over speech (Vagadhishvari). She is reached by meditation (Dhyanagamya), has no limits (Aparichchhedya), gives knowledge (Jnanada), and is knowledge in form (Jnanavigraha).

items.text:
सर्व-वेदान्त-सम्यवेद्या सत्यानन्द स्वरुपिणी ।
लोपामुदार्चिता लीलाक्लृप्त – ब्रह्माण्ड-मण्डला ।।
items.tr:
sarva-vedānta-samyavedyā satyānanda svarupiṇī |
lopāmudārcitā līlāklṛpta – brahmāṇḍa-maṇḍalā ||
items.en: She is known through all the Upanishads (Sarvavedanta-samvedya) and is truth and bliss (Satyananda-svarupini). She is worshipped by Lopamudra (Lopamudrarchita) and has made the universes as play (Lilaklripta-brahmanda-mandala).

items.text:
अदृश्या दृश्यरहिता विज्ञात्री वैद्य-वर्जिता ।
योगिनी योगदा योग्या योगानन्दा युगन्धरा ।।
items.tr:
adṛśyā dṛśyarahitā vijñātrī vaidya-varjitā |
yoginī yogadā yogyā yogānandā yugandharā ||
items.en: She cannot be seen (Adrishya), there is nothing she needs to see (Drishyarahita), she knows all (Vijnatri), and nothing is left for her to know (Vedyavarjita). She is the yogini, gives yoga (Yogada), is reached by yoga (Yogya), is the joy of yoga (Yogananda), and upholds the ages (Yugandhara).

items.text:
इच्छाशक्ति-ज्ञानशक्ति-क्रियाशक्ति-स्वरुपिणी ।
सर्वाधारा सुप्रतिष्ठा सदसद्रूप धारिणी ।।
items.tr:
icchāśakti-jñānaśakti-kriyāśakti-svarupiṇī |
sarvādhārā supratiṣṭhā sadasadrūpa dhāriṇī ||
items.en: She is the power of will, the power of knowledge and the power of action (Ichchhashakti-jnanashakti-kriyashakti-svarupini). She is the support of all (Sarvadhara), firmly established (Supratishtha), and takes both real and unreal forms (Sadasadrupa-dharini).

items.text:
अष्टमूर्ति – रजाजैत्री लोकयात्रा विधायिनी ।
एकाकिनी भूमरुपा निर्द्वैता – द्वैतवर्जिता ।।
items.tr:
aṣṭamūrti – rajājaitrī lokayātrā vidhāyinī |
ekākinī bhūmarupā nirdvaitā – dvaitavarjitā ||
items.en: She has eight forms (Ashtamurti), conquers ignorance (Ajajaitri), and directs the course of the world (Lokayatra-vidhayini). She is alone (Ekakini), the vast one (Bhumarupa), without a second (Nirdvaita), and beyond duality (Dvaitavarjita).

items.text:
अन्नदा वसुदा वृद्वा ब्रह्मात्मैक्य – स्वरुपिणी ।
बृहती ब्राह्मणी ब्राह्मी ब्रह्मानन्दा बलिप्रिया ।।
items.tr:
annadā vasudā vṛdvā brahmātmaikya – svarupiṇī |
bṛhatī brāhmaṇī brāhmī brahmānandā balipriyā ||
items.en: She gives food (Annada) and wealth (Vasuda), is ancient (Vriddha), and is the oneness of Brahman and the Self (Brahmatmaikya-svarupini). She is vast (Brihati), Brahmani, Brahmi, the bliss of Brahman (Brahmananda), and she loves offerings (Balipriya).

items.text:
भाषारुपा बृहत्सेना भावाभाव – विवर्जिता ।
सुखाराध्या शुभकरी शोभनासुलभागतिः ।।
items.tr:
bhāṣārupā bṛhatsenā bhāvābhāva – vivarjitā |
sukhārādhyā śubhakarī śobhanāsulabhāgatiḥ ||
items.en: She is all languages (Bhasharupa), has a vast army (Brihatsena), and is beyond being and not-being (Bhavabhava-vivarjita). She is easy to worship (Sukharadhya), does good (Shubhakari), and is a lovely and easy path (Shobhana-sulabhagati).

items.text:
राजराजेश्वरी राज्यदायिनी राज्यवल्लभा ।
राजत्कृपा राजपीठ – निवेशित-निजाश्रिता ।।
items.tr:
rājarājeśvarī rājyadāyinī rājyavallabhā |
rājatkṛpā rājapīṭha – niveśita-nijāśritā ||
items.en: She is the queen of the king of kings (Rajarajeshvari), gives kingdoms (Rajyadayini), and loves her kingdom (Rajyavallabha). Her mercy shines (Rajatkripa), and she seats on royal thrones those who rely on her (Rajapitha-niveshita-nijashrita).

items.text:
राज्यलक्ष्मीः कोशनाथा चतुपङ्ग – बलेश्वरी ।
साम्राज्य – दायिनी सत्यसन्धा सागरमेखला ।।
items.tr:
rājyalakṣmīḥ kośanāthā catupaṅga – baleśvarī |
sāmrājya – dāyinī satyasandhā sāgaramekhalā ||
items.en: She is the wealth of the kingdom (Rajyalakshmi), the lord of the treasury (Koshanatha), and commands the four-part army (Chaturanga-baleshvari). She gives empire (Samrajyadayini), keeps her word (Satyasandha), and wears the oceans as her girdle (Sagaramekhala).

items.text:
दीक्षिता दैत्यशमनी सर्वलोकवशंक्करी ।
सर्वार्थदात्री सावित्री सच्चिदानन्द- रुपिणी ।।
items.tr:
dīkṣitā daityaśamanī sarvalokavaśaṃkkarī |
sarvārthadātrī sāvitrī saccidānanda- rupiṇī ||
items.en: She is consecrated (Dikshita), subdues demons (Daityashamani), and wins over all the worlds (Sarvaloka-vashankari). She gives every wish (Sarvarthadatri), is Savitri, and is being, consciousness and bliss (Sachchidananda-rupini).

items.text:
देशकालापरिच्छिन्ना सर्वगा सर्वमोहिनी ।
सरस्वती शास्रमयी गुहाम्बा गुह्यारुपिणी ।।
items.tr:
deśakālāparicchinnā sarvagā sarvamohinī |
sarasvatī śāsramayī guhāmbā guhyārupiṇī ||
items.en: She is not limited by place or time (Deshakala-parichchhinna), is everywhere (Sarvaga), and enchants all (Sarvamohini). She is Sarasvati, the scriptures in form (Shastramayi), the mother of Guha (Guhamba), and has a secret form (Guhyarupini).

items.text:
सर्वोपाधि – विर्निमुक्ता सदाशिव – पतिव्रता ।
सम्प्रदायेश्वरी साध्वी गुरुमण्डल – रुपिणी ।।
items.tr:
sarvopādhi – virnimuktā sadāśiva – pativratā |
sampradāyeśvarī sādhvī gurumaṇḍala – rupiṇī ||
items.en: She is free from every limit (Sarvopadhi-vinirmukta) and is the faithful wife of Sadashiva (Sadashiva-pativrata). She rules the line of tradition (Sampradayeshvari), is virtuous (Sadhvi), and is the circle of gurus in form (Gurumandala-rupini).

items.text:
कुलोत्तीर्णा भगाराध्या माया मधुमती मही ।
गणाम्बा गुह्यकाराध्या कोमलांगी गुरुप्रिया ।।
items.tr:
kulottīrṇā bhagārādhyā māyā madhumatī mahī |
gaṇāmbā guhyakārādhyā komalāṃgī gurupriyā ||
items.en: She is beyond the Kula (Kulottirna), worshipped in the Bhaga (Bhagaradhya), is Maya, sweet (Madhumati), and the earth (Mahi). She is the mother of the Ganas (Ganamba), worshipped by the Guhyakas (Guhyakaradhya), soft in body (Komalangi), and dear to the guru (Gurupriya).

items.text:
स्वतन्त्रा सर्वतन्त्रेशी दक्षिणामूर्ति – रुपिणी ।
सनकादि – समाराध्या शिवज्ञान – प्रदायिनी ।।
items.tr:
svatantrā sarvatantreśī dakṣiṇāmūrti – rupiṇī |
sanakādi – samārādhyā śivajñāna – pradāyinī ||
items.en: She is free (Svatantra), rules all tantras (Sarvatantreshi), and has the form of Dakshinamurti. She is worshipped by Sanaka and the other sages (Sanakadi-samaradhya) and gives the knowledge of Shiva (Shivajnana-pradayini).

items.text:
चित्कलाऽऽनन्द – कलिका प्रेमरुपा प्रियंक्करी ।
नामपारायण – प्रीता नन्दिविद्या नटेश्वरी ।।
items.tr:
citkalā''nanda – kalikā premarupā priyaṃkkarī |
nāmapārāyaṇa – prītā nandividyā naṭeśvarī ||
items.en: She is a spark of consciousness (Chitkala), a bud of bliss (Anandakalika), love itself (Premarupa), and does what is dear (Priyankari). She is pleased by recitation of her names (Namaparayana-prita), is Nandividya, and is the queen of the dancer Shiva (Nateshvari).

items.text:
मिथ्या – जगदधिष्ठाना मुक्तिदा मुक्तिरुपिणी ।
लास्यप्रिया लयकरी लज्जा रम्भादिवन्दिता ।।
items.tr:
mithyā – jagadadhiṣṭhānā muktidā muktirupiṇī |
lāsyapriyā layakarī lajjā rambhādivanditā ||
items.en: She is the base on which the unreal world rests (Mithyajagad-adhishthana), gives liberation (Muktida), and is liberation itself (Muktirupini). She loves graceful dance (Lasyapriya), dissolves all (Layakari), is modesty (Lajja), and is praised by Rambha and the other heavenly dancers (Rambhadi-vandita).

items.text:
भवदाव – सुधावृष्टिः पापारण्य – दवानला ।
दौर्भाग्य – तूलवातुला जराध्वान्तरविप्रभा ।।
items.tr:
bhavadāva – sudhāvṛṣṭiḥ pāpāraṇya – davānalā |
daurbhāgya – tūlavātulā jarādhvāntaraviprabhā ||
items.en: She is a rain of nectar on the forest fire of worldly life (Bhavadava-sudhavrishti) and a forest fire for the jungle of sins (Paparanya-davanala). She is a whirlwind for the cotton of bad luck (Daurbhagya-tulavatula) and sunlight for the darkness of old age (Jaradhvanta-raviprabha).

items.text:
भाग्याब्धि – चन्द्रिका भक्त-चित्त-केकि-घनाघना ।
रोगपर्वत – दम्भोलि-र्मृत्युदारु-कुठारिका ।।
items.tr:
bhāgyābdhi – candrikā bhakta-citta-keki-ghanāghanā |
rogaparvata – dambholi-rmṛtyudāru-kuṭhārikā ||
items.en: She is moonlight for the ocean of good fortune (Bhagyabdhi-chandrika) and a rain cloud for the peacocks that are her devotees' hearts (Bhaktachitta-keki-ghanaghana). She is a thunderbolt for the mountain of disease (Rogaparvata-dambholi) and an axe for the tree of death (Mrityudaru-kutharika).

items.text:
महेश्वरी महाकाली महाग्रासा महाशना ।
अपर्णा चण्डिका चण्डमुण्डासुर – निषूदनी ।।
items.tr:
maheśvarī mahākālī mahāgrāsā mahāśanā |
aparṇā caṇḍikā caṇḍamuṇḍāsura – niṣūdanī ||
items.en: She is the great ruler (Maheshvari), Mahakali, the great devourer (Mahagrasa) and the great eater (Mahashana). She is Aparna, Chandika, and the slayer of the demons Chanda and Munda (Chandamundasura-nishudini).

items.text:
क्षराक्षरात्मिका सर्वलोकेशी विश्वधारिणी ।
त्रिवर्गदात्री सुभगा त्र्यम्बका त्रिगुणात्मिका ।।
items.tr:
kṣarākṣarātmikā sarvalokeśī viśvadhāriṇī |
trivargadātrī subhagā tryambakā triguṇātmikā ||
items.en: She is both the perishable and the imperishable (Ksharaksharatmika), the lord of all worlds (Sarvalokeshi), and holds up the universe (Vishvadharini). She gives the three goals of life (Trivargadatri), is fortunate (Subhaga), three-eyed (Tryambaka), and made of the three qualities (Trigunatmika).

items.text:
स्वर्गापवर्गदा शुद्धा जपापुष्प – निभाकृतिः ।
ओजोवती द्युतिधरा यज्ञरुपा प्रियव्रता ।।
items.tr:
svargāpavargadā śuddhā japāpuṣpa – nibhākṛtiḥ |
ojovatī dyutidharā yajñarupā priyavratā ||
items.en: She gives heaven and liberation (Svargapavargada), is pure (Shuddha), and her form is red like the hibiscus flower (Japapushpa-nibhakritih). She is full of vigour (Ojovati), holds light (Dyutidhara), is sacrifice in form (Yajnarupa), and loves sacred vows (Priyavrata).

items.text:
दुराराध्या दुराधर्षा पाटली – कुसुम-प्रिया ।
महती मेरुनिलया मन्दार-कुसुम-प्रिया ।।
items.tr:
durārādhyā durādharṣā pāṭalī – kusuma-priyā |
mahatī merunilayā mandāra-kusuma-priyā ||
items.en: She is hard to worship (Duraradhya), cannot be overcome (Duradharsha), and loves patali flowers (Patalikusuma-priya). She is great (Mahati), lives on Mount Meru (Merunilaya), and loves mandara flowers (Mandarakusuma-priya).

items.text:
वीराराध्या विराड्रुपा विरजा विश्वतोमुखी ।
प्रत्यग् – रुपा पराकाशा प्राणदा प्राणरुपिणी ।।
items.tr:
vīrārādhyā virāḍrupā virajā viśvatomukhī |
pratyag – rupā parākāśā prāṇadā prāṇarupiṇī ||
items.en: She is worshipped by heroes (Viraradhya), is the cosmic form (Viradrupa), is stainless (Viraja), and faces every way (Vishvatomukhi). She is the inner self (Pratyagrupa), the highest space (Parakasha), gives life (Pranada), and is life itself (Pranarupini).

items.text:
मार्ताण्ड – भैरवाराध्या मन्त्रिणी-न्यस्त-राज्यधूः ।
त्रिपुरेशी जयत्सेना निस्रैगुण्या परापरा ।।
items.tr:
mārtāṇḍa – bhairavārādhyā mantriṇī-nyasta-rājyadhūḥ |
tripureśī jayatsenā nisraiguṇyā parāparā ||
items.en: She is worshipped by Martanda Bhairava (Martanda-bhairavaradhya) and has handed the burden of ruling to Mantrini (Mantrini-nyasta-rajyadhuh). She rules Tripura (Tripureshi), has a victorious army (Jayatsena), is beyond the three qualities (Nistraigunya), and is both the higher and the lower (Parapara).

items.text:
सत्यज्ञानान्द – रुपा सामरस्य – परायणा ।
कपर्दिनी कलामाला कामधु-क्काम-रुपिणी ।।
items.tr:
satyajñānānda – rupā sāmarasya – parāyaṇā |
kapardinī kalāmālā kāmadhu-kkāma-rupiṇī ||
items.en: She is truth, knowledge and bliss (Satyajnanananda-rupa) and is devoted to perfect oneness (Samarasya-parayana). She is the wife of Shiva of the matted hair (Kapardini), wears a garland of arts (Kalamala), grants every wish (Kamadhuk), and takes any form she wishes (Kamarupini).

items.text:
कलानिधिः काव्यकला रसज्ञा रसशेवधिः ।
पुष्टा पुरातना पूज्या पुष्करा पुष्करेक्षणा ।।
items.tr:
kalānidhiḥ kāvyakalā rasajñā rasaśevadhiḥ |
puṣṭā purātanā pūjyā puṣkarā puṣkarekṣaṇā ||
items.en: She is a treasure of arts (Kalanidhi), the art of poetry (Kavyakala), knows every taste (Rasajna), and is a store of delight (Rasashevadhi). She is well nourished (Pushta), ancient (Puratana), worthy of worship (Pujya), the lotus (Pushkara), and lotus-eyed (Pushkarekshana).

items.text:
परञ्ज्योतिः परन्धाम परमाणुः परात्परा ।
पाशहत्सा पाशहन्त्री परमन्त्र – विभेदनी ।।
items.tr:
parañjyotiḥ parandhāma paramāṇuḥ parātparā |
pāśahatsā pāśahantrī paramantra – vibhedanī ||
items.en: She is the supreme light (Paramjyoti), the supreme home (Paramdhama), the finest atom (Paramanu), and higher than the highest (Paratpara). She holds the noose (Pashahasta), cuts all bonds (Pashahantri), and breaks the spells of enemies (Paramantra-vibhedini).

items.text:
मूर्ताऽमूर्ता नित्यतृप्ता मुनिमानस – हंसिका ।
सत्यव्रता सत्यरुपा सर्वान्तर्यामिनी सती ।।
items.tr:
mūrtā'mūrtā nityatṛptā munimānasa – haṃsikā |
satyavratā satyarupā sarvāntaryāminī satī ||
items.en: She has form and is also formless (Murta, Amurta), is ever content (Nityatripta), and is the swan in the minds of sages (Munimanasa-hamsika). She keeps her vows (Satyavrata), is truth itself (Satyarupa), the inner ruler of all (Sarvantaryamini), and is Sati.

items.text:
ब्रह्माणी ब्रह्मजननी बहुरुपा बुधार्चिता ।
प्रसवित्री प्रचण्डाऽऽज्ञा प्रतिष्ठा प्रकटाकृतिः ।।
items.tr:
brahmāṇī brahmajananī bahurupā budhārcitā |
prasavitrī pracaṇḍā''jñā pratiṣṭhā prakaṭākṛtiḥ ||
items.en: She is Brahmani, the mother of Brahma (Brahmajanani), has many forms (Bahurupa), and is worshipped by the wise (Budharchita). She gives birth to all (Prasavitri), her command is fierce (Prachandajna), she is the foundation (Pratishtha), and her form is plain to see (Prakatakritih).

items.text:
प्राणेश्वरी प्राणदात्री पञ्चाशत्पीठ – रुपिणी ।
विश्वृंखला विवित्तस्था वीरमाता वियत्सप्रसुः ।।
items.tr:
prāṇeśvarī prāṇadātrī pañcāśatpīṭha – rupiṇī |
viśvṛṃkhalā vivittasthā vīramātā viyatsaprasuḥ ||
items.en: She is the lord of life (Praneshvari), gives life (Pranadatri), and is the fifty holy seats (Panchashatpitha-rupini). She is free of all chains (Vishrinkhala), lives in solitude (Viviktastha), is the mother of heroes (Viramata), and the source of space (Viyatprasuh).

items.text:
मुकुन्दा मक्तिनिलया मूलविग्रह-रुपिणी ।
भावज्ञा भवरोगघ्नी भवचक्र-प्रवर्तिनी ।।
items.tr:
mukundā maktinilayā mūlavigraha-rupiṇī |
bhāvajñā bhavarogaghnī bhavacakra-pravartinī ||
items.en: She is Mukunda, the home of liberation (Muktinilaya), and the root form of all (Mulavigraha-rupini). She knows all feelings (Bhavajna), cures the disease of worldly life (Bhavarogaghni), and turns the wheel of births (Bhavachakra-pravartini).

items.text:
छन्दः सारा शास्रसारा मन्त्रसारा तलोदरी ।
उदारकीर्ति – रुद्दामवैभवा वर्णरुपिणी ।।
items.tr:
chandaḥ sārā śāsrasārā mantrasārā talodarī |
udārakīrti – ruddāmavaibhavā varṇarupiṇī ||
items.en: She is the essence of the Vedas (Chhandahsara), of the scriptures (Shastrasara) and of the mantras (Mantrasara), and has a slender waist (Talodari). Her fame is noble (Udarakirti), her glory has no bounds (Uddamavaibhava), and her form is the letters (Varnarupini).

items.text:
जन्ममृत्यु – जरातप्त-जन-विश्रांति-दायिनी ।
सर्वोप्निष-दुद्घुष्टा शान्त्यतीत – कलात्मिका ।।
items.tr:
janmamṛtyu – jarātapta-jana-viśrāṃti-dāyinī |
sarvopniṣa-dudghuṣṭā śāntyatīta – kalātmikā ||
items.en: She gives rest to people worn out by birth, death and old age (Janmamrityu-jaratapta-jana-vishranti-dayini). All the Upanishads proclaim her (Sarvopanishad-udghushta), and she is the power that lies beyond peace (Shantyatita-kalatmika).

items.text:
गम्भीरा गगनान्तस्था गर्विता गानलोलुपा ।
कल्पना – रहिता काष्ठाऽकान्ता कान्तार्ध – विग्रहा ।।
items.tr:
gambhīrā gaganāntasthā garvitā gānalolupā |
kalpanā – rahitā kāṣṭhā'kāntā kāntārdha – vigrahā ||
items.en: She is deep (Gambhira), lives within the sky (Gaganantastha), is proud (Garvita), and loves music (Ganalolupa). She is free of imagining (Kalpanarahita), the final limit (Kashtha), free of sin (Akanta), and half of her beloved's body (Kantardha-vigraha).

items.text:
कार्यकारण – निर्मुक्ता कामकेलि – तरङ्गिता ।
कनत्कनक –ताटंक्का लीला-विग्रह-धारिणी ।।
items.tr:
kāryakāraṇa – nirmuktā kāmakeli – taraṅgitā |
kanatkanaka –tāṭaṃkkā līlā-vigraha-dhāriṇī ||
items.en: She is free of cause and effect (Karyakarana-nirmukta) and full of waves of love-play with Kameshvara (Kamakeli-tarangita). She wears shining gold earrings (Kanatkanaka-tatanka) and takes bodies in play (Lilavigraha-dharini).

items.text:
अजा क्षयविर्निर्मुक्ता मुग्धा क्षिप्र-प्रसादिनी ।
अन्तर्मुख – समाराध्या बहिर्मुख – सुदुर्लभा ।।
items.tr:
ajā kṣayavirnirmuktā mugdhā kṣipra-prasādinī |
antarmukha – samārādhyā bahirmukha – sudurlabhā ||
items.en: She is unborn (Aja), free of decay (Kshayavinirmukta), innocent and charming (Mugdha), and quick to give grace (Kshipraprasadini). She is worshipped by those who turn inward (Antarmukha-samaradhya) and is very hard to reach for those who look outward (Bahirmukha-sudurlabha).

items.text:
त्रयी त्रिवर्ग- निलया त्रिस्था त्रिपुर – मालिनी ।
निरामया निरालम्बा स्वात्मारामा सुधासृतिः ।।
items.tr:
trayī trivarga- nilayā tristhā tripura – mālinī |
nirāmayā nirālambā svātmārāmā sudhāsṛtiḥ ||
items.en: She is the three Vedas (Trayi), the home of the three goals of life (Trivarganilaya), lives in the three worlds (Tristha), and wears the garland of Tripura (Tripuramalini). She is free of disease (Niramaya), needs no support (Niralamba), delights in her own Self (Svatmarama), and is a stream of nectar (Sudhasriti).

items.text:
संसारपङ्क – निमर्ग्र – समुद्धरण – पण्डिता ।
यज्ञप्रिया यज्ञकर्त्री यजमान – स्वरुपिणी ।।
items.tr:
saṃsārapaṅka – nimargra – samuddharaṇa – paṇḍitā |
yajñapriyā yajñakartrī yajamāna – svarupiṇī ||
items.en: She is skilled at lifting out those sunk in the mud of worldly life (Samsarapanka-nirmagna-samuddharana-pandita). She loves sacrifice (Yajnapriya), performs it (Yajnakartri), and is the one who offers it (Yajamana-svarupini).

items.text:
धर्माधारा धनाध्यक्षा धनधान्य – विवार्धिनी ।
विप्रप्रिया विप्ररुपा विश्वभ्रमण – कारिणी ।।
items.tr:
dharmādhārā dhanādhyakṣā dhanadhānya – vivārdhinī |
viprapriyā viprarupā viśvabhramaṇa – kāriṇī ||
items.en: She is the support of dharma (Dharmadhara), the keeper of wealth (Dhanadhyaksha), and increases wealth and grain (Dhanadhanya-vivardhini). She loves the learned (Viprapriya), is the learned one (Viprarupa), and makes the universe turn (Vishvabhramana-karini).

items.text:
विश्वग्रासा विद्रुमाभा वैष्णवी विष्णुरुपिणी ।
अयोनि –र्योनि-निलया कूटस्था कुलरुपिणी ।।
items.tr:
viśvagrāsā vidrumābhā vaiṣṇavī viṣṇurupiṇī |
ayoni –ryoni-nilayā kūṭasthā kularupiṇī ||
items.en: She swallows the universe (Vishvagrasa), glows like coral (Vidrumabha), is Vaishnavi, and has Vishnu's form (Vishnurupini). She has no source (Ayoni), is the source of all (Yoninilaya), is unchanging (Kutastha), and is the Kula in form (Kularupini).

items.text:
वीरगोष्ठी – प्रिया वीरा नैष्कर्म्या नादरुपिणी ।
विज्ञानकलना कल्या विदग्धा बैन्दवासना ।।
items.tr:
vīragoṣṭhī – priyā vīrā naiṣkarmyā nādarupiṇī |
vijñānakalanā kalyā vidagdhā baindavāsanā ||
items.en: She loves the company of heroes (Viragoshthi-priya), is a heroine (Vira), is beyond action (Naishkarmya), and is sound in form (Nadarupini). She is the grasp of true knowledge (Vijnanakalana), able (Kalya), skilled (Vidagdha), and sits in the bindu (Baindavasana).

items.text:
तत्तवाधिका तत्वमयी त्तत्वमर्थ – स्वरुपिणी ।
सामगन – प्रिया सोम्या सदाशिव – कुटुम्बिनी ।।
items.tr:
tattavādhikā tatvamayī ttatvamartha – svarupiṇī |
sāmagana – priyā somyā sadāśiva – kuṭumbinī ||
items.en: She is beyond the principles (Tattvadhika), made of them (Tattvamayi), and is the meaning of 'That' and 'you' (Tattvamartha-svarupini). She loves the chanting of the Sama Veda (Samagana-priya), is gentle (Saumya), and is the wife of Sadashiva (Sadashiva-kutumbini).

items.text:
सव्यापसव्य – मार्गस्था सर्वापद्धिनिवारिणी ।
स्वस्था स्वभावमधुरा धीरा धीरसमर्चिता ।।
items.tr:
savyāpasavya – mārgasthā sarvāpaddhinivāriṇī |
svasthā svabhāvamadhurā dhīrā dhīrasamarcitā ||
