items.en: She stands on both the right and the left paths (Savyapasavya-margastha) and removes all dangers (Sarvapadvinivarini). She rests in herself (Svastha), is sweet by nature (Svabhavamadhura), wise and steady (Dhira), and worshipped by the wise (Dhirasamarchita).

items.text:
चैतन्यार्ध्य – समाराध्या चैतन्य-कुसुम-प्रिया ।
सदोदिता सदातुष्टा तरुणादित्य – पाटला ।।
items.tr:
caitanyārdhya – samārādhyā caitanya-kusuma-priyā |
sadoditā sadātuṣṭā taruṇāditya – pāṭalā ||
items.en: She is worshipped with the offering of consciousness (Chaitanyarghya-samaradhya) and loves the flower of consciousness (Chaitanyakusuma-priya). She is always shining (Sadodita), always content (Sadatushta), and rosy like the young sun (Tarunaditya-patala).

items.text:
दक्षिणा – दक्षिणाराध्या दरस्मेर-मुखाम्बुजा ।
कौलिनी - केवऽनर्घ्य – कैवल्य-पद-दायिनी ।।
items.tr:
dakṣiṇā – dakṣiṇārādhyā darasmera-mukhāmbujā |
kaulinī - keva'narghya – kaivalya-pada-dāyinī ||
items.en: She is worshipped on both the right and the left paths (Dakshinadakshinaradhya), and her lotus face smiles gently (Darasmera-mukhambuja). She is Kaulini, the only one (Kevala), and gives the priceless state of final freedom (Anarghya-kaivalya-pada-dayini).

items.text:
स्तोत्र-प्रिया स्तुतिमती श्रुति-संस्तुत-वैभवा ।
मन्स्विनी मानवती महेशी मंङ्ग्लाकृतिः ।।
items.tr:
stotra-priyā stutimatī śruti-saṃstuta-vaibhavā |
mansvinī mānavatī maheśī maṃṅglākṛtiḥ ||
items.en: She loves hymns (Stotrapriya), is worthy of praise (Stutimati), and her glory is praised by the Vedas (Shrutisamstuta-vaibhava). She is wise (Manasvini), dignified (Manavati), the great goddess (Maheshi), and auspicious in form (Mangalakritih).

items.text:
विश्वमाता जगद्धात्री विशालाक्षी विरागिणी ।
प्रगल्भा परमोदारा परामोदा मनोमयी ।।
items.tr:
viśvamātā jagaddhātrī viśālākṣī virāgiṇī |
pragalbhā paramodārā parāmodā manomayī ||
items.en: She is the mother of the universe (Vishvamata), the upholder of the world (Jagaddhatri), wide-eyed (Vishalakshi), and free of passion (Viragini). She is bold (Pragalbha), most generous (Paramodara), full of supreme joy (Paramoda), and made of mind (Manomayi).

items.text:
व्योमकेशी विमानस्था वज्रिणी वामकेश्वरी ।
पञ्चयज्ञ प्रिया पञ्चप्रेत-मञ्चाधिशायिनी ।।
items.tr:
vyomakeśī vimānasthā vajriṇī vāmakeśvarī |
pañcayajña priyā pañcapreta-mañcādhiśāyinī ||
items.en: The sky is her hair (Vyomakeshi); she rides a heavenly chariot (Vimanastha), holds the thunderbolt (Vajrini), and is Vamakeshvari. She loves the five sacrifices (Panchayajna-priya) and rests on a couch made of five lifeless forms (Panchapreta-manchadhishayini).

items.text:
पञ्चमी पञ्चभूतेशी पञ्चसंख्योपचारिणी ।
शाश्वती शाश्वतैश्वर्या शर्मदा शम्भुमोहिनी ।।
items.tr:
pañcamī pañcabhūteśī pañcasaṃkhyopacāriṇī |
śāśvatī śāśvataiśvaryā śarmadā śambhumohinī ||
items.en: She is Panchami, the ruler of the five elements (Panchabhuteshi), and is worshipped with five offerings (Panchasankhyopacharini). She is eternal (Shashvati), her lordship is eternal (Shashvataishvarya), she gives happiness (Sharmada), and she charms Shambhu (Shambhumohini).

items.text:
धरा धरसुता धन्या धर्मिणी धर्मवर्धिनी ।
लोकातीता गुणातीता सर्वातीता शमात्मिका ।।
items.tr:
dharā dharasutā dhanyā dharmiṇī dharmavardhinī |
lokātītā guṇātītā sarvātītā śamātmikā ||
items.en: She is the earth (Dhara), the daughter of the mountain (Dharasuta), blessed (Dhanya), righteous (Dharmini), and increases dharma (Dharmavardhini). She is beyond the worlds (Lokatita), beyond qualities (Gunatita), beyond all (Sarvatita), and peace itself (Shamatmika).

items.text:
बन्धुक-कुसुम-प्रख्या बाला लीला-विनोदिनी ।
सुमङ्गली सुखकरी सवेषाढ्या सुवासिनी ।।
items.tr:
bandhuka-kusuma-prakhyā bālā līlā-vinodinī |
sumaṅgalī sukhakarī saveṣāḍhyā suvāsinī ||
items.en: She glows like the red bandhuka flower (Bandhuka-kusuma-prakhya), is the young girl Bala, and delights in play (Lilavinodini). She is fully auspicious (Sumangali), gives joy (Sukhakari), is finely dressed (Suveshadhya), and is a happily married woman (Suvasini).

items.text: सुवासिन्यर्चन-प्रीताऽऽशोभना शुद्ध-मानसा ।।
items.tr: suvāsinyarcana-prītā''śobhanā śuddha-mānasā ||
items.en: She is pleased by the worship of married women (Suvasinyarchana-prita), is radiant (Ashobhana), and has a pure mind (Shuddhamanasa).

items.text: बिन्दु-तर्पण-सन्तुष्टा पूर्वजा त्रिपुराम्बिका ।।
items.tr: bindu-tarpaṇa-santuṣṭā pūrvajā tripurāmbikā ||
items.en: She is pleased by offerings to the bindu (Bindu-tarpana-santushta), is the first-born (Purvaja), and is Tripurambika, the mother of Tripura.

items.text:
दशमुद्रा-समाराध्या त्रिपुराश्रीवशंक्करी ।
ज्ञानमुद्रा ज्ञानगम्या ज्ञान-ज्ञेय-स्वरुपिणी ।।
items.tr:
daśamudrā-samārādhyā tripurāśrīvaśaṃkkarī |
jñānamudrā jñānagamyā jñāna-jñeya-svarupiṇī ||
items.en: She is worshipped with the ten mudras (Dashamudra-samaradhya) and holds Tripurashri in her power (Tripurashri-vashankari). She is the mudra of knowledge (Jnanamudra), reached by knowledge (Jnanagamya), and is both knowledge and what is known (Jnanajneya-svarupini).

items.text:
योनिमुद्रा त्रिखण्डेशी त्रिगुणाम्बा त्रिकोणगा ।
अनघाऽद्भुत- चारिता वाञ्छितार्थ – प्रदायिनी ।।
items.tr:
yonimudrā trikhaṇḍeśī triguṇāmbā trikoṇagā |
anaghā'dbhuta- cāritā vāñchitārtha – pradāyinī ||
items.en: She is the yoni mudra (Yonimudra), the ruler of the three parts (Trikhandeshi), the mother of the three qualities (Trigunamba), and dwells in the triangle (Trikonaga). She is sinless (Anagha), her deeds are wonderful (Adbhutacharitra), and she grants what one wishes for (Vanchhitartha-pradayini).

items.text:
अभ्यासातिशय – ज्ञाता षडध्वातीत – रुपिणी ।
अव्याज-करुणा-मूर्ति-रज्ञान-ध्वान्त-दीपिका ।।
items.tr:
abhyāsātiśaya – jñātā ṣaḍadhvātīta – rupiṇī |
avyāja-karuṇā-mūrti-rajñāna-dhvānta-dīpikā ||
items.en: She is known through long and steady practice (Abhyasatishaya-jnata) and is beyond the six paths (Shadadhvatita-rupini). She is mercy that needs no reason (Avyajakaruna-murti) and a lamp in the darkness of ignorance (Ajnanadhvanta-dipika).

items.text:
आबाल – गोप-विदिता सर्वानुल्लंघ्य-शासना ।
श्रीचक्रराज निलया श्रीमत्-त्रिपुरसुन्दरी ।।
items.tr:
ābāla – gopa-viditā sarvānullaṃghya-śāsanā |
śrīcakrarāja nilayā śrīmat-tripurasundarī ||
items.en: She is known to all, even children and cowherds (Abalagopa-vidita), and no one can disobey her command (Sarvanullanghya-shasana). She lives in the Shri Chakra (Shrichakraraja-nilaya) and is the holy Tripurasundari (Shrimat-tripurasundari).

items.text:
श्री शिवा शिव –शक्त्यैक्य-रुपिणी ललिताम्बिका ।
एवं श्रीललितादेव्या नाम्नां साहस्रकं जगुः ।।
items.tr:
śrī śivā śiva –śaktyaikya-rupiṇī lalitāmbikā |
evaṃ śrīlalitādevyā nāmnāṃ sāhasrakaṃ jaguḥ ||
items.en: She is the holy auspicious one (Shrishiva), the oneness of Shiva and Shakti (Shivashaktyaikya-rupini), and Lalitambika. In this way the goddesses of speech sang the thousand names of the goddess Shri Lalita.

items.text:
।।इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डपुराणे उत्तरखण्डे श्रीहयग्रीवागस्त्य-संवादे
श्री ललितासहस्रनाम-स्तोत्रं सम्पूर्णम् ।।
items.tr:
||iti śrībrahmāṇḍapurāṇe uttarakhaṇḍe śrīhayagrīvāgastya-saṃvāde
śrī lalitāsahasranāma-stotraṃ sampūrṇam ||
items.en: Here ends the hymn of the thousand names of Shri Lalita, from the dialogue of Shri Hayagriva and Agastya in the last part of the Brahmanda Purana.
